papers.title: Assessing Invasion Risk and Associated Economic Loss of Fish Species Across Global Watersheds Using Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.authors: Suh, Sang-Ik; Kim, Dahui; Lee, Bumseok; Lee, Soheon; Ki, Seo Jin
papers.abstract: The intention of this study is to compare invasion risk and economic loss for selected fish species in both different watersheds and countries on a global scale. The potential risk of invasion for four different species was assessed by the prediction models developed from machine learning algorithms and joint dataset comprising species occurrence records and relevant environmental information. Combining invasion risk and unit economic costs derived from a comprehensive invasion cost database also enabled us to calculate the economic loss of invaders in three example countries. Results showed that the multi-layer perceptron algorithm, which was selected as the best model out of them, successfully identified areas of very-high-to-no risk for four selected fishes. The potential risk of invasion was relatively high for Perccottus glenii and low for Salmo trutta in the Republic of Korea, as compared to that of Japan and Australia. In addition, both invasion risk and unit economic costs were found to be largely responsible for the economic loss of selected fish species, specifically the species Petromyzon marinus in Australia. We expect that the methodology proposed in this study can be used to address the potential risk of invasion for non-native species along with other similar models such as species distribution models, and can be used to recommend affordable management options for controlling their populations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用机器学习算法结合物种分布记录与环境数据，构建预测模型评估全球流域和不同国家中四种鱼类的入侵风险，并整合入侵成本数据库计算经济损失。结果显示多层感知器算法表现最佳，成功划分从极高到无风险区域；在韩国，葛鲈（Perccottus glenii）入侵风险较高，而褐鳟（Salmo trutta）较低，与日本和澳大利亚相比差异显著。经济损失主要受入侵风险和单位经济成本驱动，尤其以澳大利亚的海七鳃鳗（Petromyzon marinus）最为突出。该方法可推广至其他非本地物种的入侵风险评估，并为制定经济可行的种群管控策略提供支持。

papers.title: Invasives in the dark: An established population of the arrow bulleye Priacanthus sagittarius on the aphotic continental slope of the eastern Mediterranean
papers.authors: Stern, Nir; Nazarova, Sophia
papers.abstract: Abstract Although the eastern Mediterranean is recognized as the most heavily invaded marine region worldwide, such incursions have been documented almost exclusively in coastal and upper‐shelf habitats. Here, we present the first record of a fish invasion into the Mediterranean's aphotic zone, reporting nine specimens of the arrow bulleye Priacanthus sagittarius captured at a depth of 420 m on the sandy continental slope off the Israeli coast. DNA‐based analysis of stomach contents identified deep‐sea prey taxa, providing robust evidence that this non‐indigenous species is actively feeding within the deep benthic environments of the Mediterranean Sea. In addition, analyses of genetic population structure indicate a downward expansion of local continental populations and reveal cryptic diversity between native populations along the Indian and West Pacific Ocean and the Red Sea and invasive Mediterranean populations. The potential ecological consequences of colonizing and exploiting new deep‐sea habitats are also explored.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次记录鱼类入侵地中海无光区，在以色列海岸外420米深的砂质大陆坡捕获9尾箭大眼鲷（Priacanthus sagittarius）。基于DNA的胃含物分析鉴定出深海底栖猎物，证实该外来种在地中海深水环境中主动摄食。种群遗传结构分析显示，本地大陆种群存在向下扩张，并揭示印度洋-西太平洋原生种群与红海-地中海入侵种群间的隐性多样性。研究还探讨了拓殖和利用新深海栖息地的潜在生态后果。

papers.title: An Update on Advancement in Genomics Resources for Spiny Lobster Aquaculture Development
papers.authors: Lewis, Courtney; Farhadi, Ahmad; Glendinning, Susan; Banks, Thomas; Kelly, Tara; Jeffs, Andrew G.; Villamil, Sandra Infante; Breen, John; Cobcroft, Jennifer M.; Vazirzadeh, Arya
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid advancement of high‐throughput sequencing technologies has transformed aquaculture genomics, enabling unprecedented insights into the biology and improvement of non‐model aquatic species. Among crustaceans, lobsters represent one of the most commercially valuable yet genomically underexplored taxa. This review synthesises the current state of genomic and transcriptomic resources available for spiny and slipper lobsters (Achelata), contextualising these within the broader decapod framework. We outline key genomic assemblies, transcriptomic atlases, and molecular tools that underpin emerging research on reproduction, nutrition, growth, stress tolerance, and disease resistance. We further highlight how omics‐driven approaches—spanning whole‐genome sequencing, SNP discovery, RNA interference, and nutrigenomics—are reshaping opportunities for selective breeding, reproductive control, and feed optimisation. Recent progress in establishing closed‐cycle aquaculture of Panulirus ornatus now provides the foundation for applying these molecular resources to address key production bottlenecks, including larval duration, cannibalism, and asynchronous moulting. We propose future directions integrating genomics, transcriptomics, and functional tools to accelerate sustainable domestication and genetic improvement of lobsters. Together, these advances mark a pivotal shift toward genomically informed spiny lobster aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述总结了刺龙虾和蝉虾（Achelata）基因组与转录组资源的最新进展，涵盖基因组组装、转录组图谱及分子工具在繁殖、营养、生长、应激耐受和抗病研究中的应用。重点阐述了全基因组测序、SNP发现、RNA干扰及营养基因组学等组学方法如何推动选择性育种、繁殖调控和饲料优化。基于Panulirus ornatus闭式循环养殖的近期突破，提出整合基因组学与功能工具以解决幼虫周期、同类相食和蜕皮不同步等生产瓶颈的未来方向，标志着向基因组指导的刺龙虾养殖转型。

papers.title:
Trophic niche overlap between native and non‐native fishes in central
                    <scp>Anatolian</scp>
                    lakes,
                    <scp>Türkiye</scp>
papers.authors: Ramírez‐García, Arely; Korkmaz, Mustafa; Pacheco, Juan Pablo; Tavşanoğlu, Ülkü Nihan; Pita‐Zamudio, Marco V.; Acar, Vildan; Aznarez, Celina; Metin, Melisa; Dede, Cemreay; Yılmaz, Gültekin
papers.abstract: Abstract The Central Anatolian region of Türkiye exhibits exceptionally high freshwater fish diversity and endemism and is increasingly exposed to the introduction of non‐native taxa. We examined the diet composition, prey selectivity and interspecific dietary overlap among eight native and five non‐native fish species across seven lakes in Central Anatolia. Fish were sampled using multimesh gill nets and fyke nets, and their stomach contents were identified. In addition, zooplankton and benthic macroinvertebrate communities were quantified to evaluate prey selectivity patterns. Aquatic insects were the main food sources (averaging 60%), followed by cladocerans (25%), for both native and non‐native fish species. Horn's index indicated a high dietary overlap (>0.60) between several native and non‐native species, suggesting substantial overlap in resource use and the potential for exploitative interactions. Native species generally exhibited more specialized diets, whereas non‐native species tended to be generalists. Prey selectivity analysis revealed that both native and non‐native species preferentially consumed aquatic insects over other available prey types, indicating shared reliance on benthic food resources. These findings suggest that non‐native fishes may influence trophic structure and resource use patterns in freshwater ecosystems with high endemism. We emphasize the importance of region‐specific monitoring and management strategies to mitigate the ecological impacts of non‐native fishes and support the conservation of Türkiye's freshwater biodiversity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了土耳其安纳托利亚中部7个湖泊中8种本地和5种外来鱼类的食性组成、猎物选择及种间食性重叠。结果显示，水生昆虫（平均60%）和枝角类（25%）是主要食物来源，Horn指数表明多种本地与外来鱼类间存在高度食性重叠（>0.60），且本地种食性更特化，外来种更偏向泛化。两者均优先摄食水生昆虫，提示外来鱼类可能通过资源竞争影响高特有性淡水生态系统的营养结构，需加强区域监测与管理以保护当地生物多样性。

papers.title: Insights into diet and niche separation in the context of prey availability between two sympatric whiprays in a tropical intertidal estuary
papers.authors: Myers, Jaelen; Sheaves, Marcus; Barnett, Adam
papers.abstract: Abstract Increasing evidence supports associations between various elasmobranch species and estuarine habitats, particularly during early life stages. However, with substantial knowledge gaps surrounding spatial habitat use and trophic ecology of estuary‐associated species in Australia, we cannot reliably assess the functional importance of these areas or identify relevant drivers of resource partitioning in estuarine food webs. Here, we compared the diets and trophic niches of two sympatric dasyatid species, the Australian whipray Himantura australis and brown whipray Maculabatis toshi, in a tropical estuary in North Queensland. Stomach contents were collected from juvenile specimens in 2022–2025 using gastric lavage, muscle tissue samples were analysed for stable isotopes (δ 13 C, δ 15 N) and invertebrate communities were surveyed to contextualise prey availability in the intertidal zone. Dietary composition differed significantly between species, with H. australis showing a stronger reliance on burrowing crustaceans (e.g., Callianassidae and Mictyridae), while M. toshi consumed more epibenthic crustaceans (e.g., Ogyrididae, Penaeidae, Portunidae). Himantura australis occupied a larger isotopic niche space than M. toshi , and there was no trophic overlap of larger size classes of H. australis (>50 cm disc width) with M. toshi or with smaller conspecifics (<50 cm disc width). Prey availability was spatially variable and indicated that while both species target locally abundant crustacean taxa, resources may be partitioned across different sediment layers. These findings highlight the importance of estuaries as feeding grounds for juvenile rays and suggest that morphological and behavioural adaptations may drive dietary variability between similar species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了澳大利亚热带河口两种同域分布的魟鱼——澳洲魟（Himantura australis）和褐魟（Maculabatis toshi）的食性与营养生态位，通过胃内容物分析、稳定同位素（δ¹³C、δ¹⁵N）测定及底栖无脊椎动物群落调查，揭示了猎物可利用性对资源分配的影响。结果显示，两物种食性显著分化：澳洲魟更依赖穴居甲壳类（如Callianassidae和Mictyridae），而褐魟主要摄食表栖甲壳类（如Ogyrididae、Penaeidae、Portunidae）；澳洲魟占据更宽的isotopic niche空间，且大型个体（>50 cm disc width）与褐魟及小型同种个体无营养重叠。猎物空间分布不均，表明两物种虽均利用当地丰富的甲壳类资源，但可能通过不同沉积层进行资源分割。研究强调了河口作为幼年魟鱼摄食场的重要性，并提示形态和行为适应驱动了相似物种间的食性差异。

papers.title: Biochemical analysis and antimicrobial potential of Mastacembelus armatus epidermal mucus
papers.authors: Khan, Muhammad Saeed; Ali, Shandana; Qasim, Muhammad; Dawar, Farman Ullah; Ullah, Waheed
papers.abstract: Abstract The epidermal mucus of fish plays an important role in innate immunity, providing both physical and biochemical protection through a complex matrix of bioactive molecules. The present study explored the biochemical characterization, bactericidal, and fungicidal activities of Mastacembelus armatus (Zig‐Zag eel) epidermal mucus treated with Aeromonas hydrophila . Extracts of epidermal mucus (ethanolic and acidic) of Mastacembelus armatus showed antimicrobial activity against selected resistant bacteria and fungi. The zone of inhibition (ZOI), which was measured in millimetres, revealed differences in activity between different fungi and bacteria. The acidic extract demonstrated noticeably higher ZOI values against various MDR bacteria and fungi was more effective than the ethanolic extract. Strong peaks in the Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectrum of Mastacembelus armatus indicated the presence of metabolic components in the epidermal mucus. The O–H and N–H stretching vibrations, which are indicative of water content and protein‐based molecules such as mucins or amide, are shown by a large peak at 3272.60 cm −1 . This result suggests that fish epidermal mucus has the potential to contribute enormously to the defence of fish against bacteria and fungi. Therefore, this study could be evidence in favour of the substitution of chemical antibiotics with fish epidermal mucus as a new ‘antimicrobial’ introduced in aquaculture and in humans against bacterial infections.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对刺鳅（*Mastacembelus armatus*）表皮黏液进行生化分析，并评估其经嗜水气单胞菌诱导后的抗菌和抗真菌活性。酸性提取物对多种多重耐药（MDR）细菌和真菌的抑菌圈（ZOI）显著高于乙醇提取物，FTIR光谱显示3272.60 cm⁻¹处强峰表明存在蛋白质类生物活性分子（如黏蛋白）。结果表明，鱼类表皮黏液可作为水产养殖及人类抗细菌感染的潜在天然抗菌替代品。

papers.title: Tracking Eastward Displacement of Pacific Saury Fishing Grounds Using Nighttime Fishing Radiance: The Role of Early‐Season Kuroshio Extension Variability
papers.authors: Tian, Hao; Abe, Hiroto; Liu, Yang; Chen, Bingqing; Kang, Bin; Li, Jianchao; Saitoh, Sei‐Ichi; Cao, Chang; Li, Wenjia; Xu, Hui
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Pacific saury ( Cololabis saira ) is an ecologically and commercially important small pelagic species in the northwestern Pacific, where fishing grounds have shifted markedly eastward in recent years. However, the role of early‐season oceanographic variability in shaping this redistribution remains poorly understood. Using catch records, Automatic identification systems‐derived fishing hours, vessel registry data, and nighttime light (NTL) observations, we examined fishing activity during 2012–2020 and linked fishing‐ground displacement to environmental variability and Kuroshio Extension system (KES) hydrographic conditions. NTL radiance outperformed CPUE and fishing hours in representing environmentally structured fishing‐ground variability, highlighting its value for tracking transboundary displacement in this light‐luring fishery. The optimal random forest model identified mixed layer depth, sea surface salinity, phytoplankton carbon, and sea surface temperature (SST) as the dominant predictors. Radiance‐weighted centers of gravity revealed especially strong eastward displacement in 2019–2020. Early‐season (May–July) displacement was strongly associated with annual displacement, indicating that the annual fishing‐ground pattern was largely preconditioned during the early‐season. Among the dominant environmental variables, SST displacement in the traditional fishing grounds showed the strongest relationship with the eastward shift. Years with longer Kuroshio Extension fronts and higher regional mean KE showed greater eastward displacement, indicating an association between early‐season KES‐related hydrographic variability, thermal reorganization of the traditional fishing grounds, and eastward redistribution. These findings demonstrate the value of nighttime fishing radiance for detecting environmentally structured fishery redistribution and suggest that early‐season KES‐related hydrographic variability is an important oceanographic context for the recent eastward shift of saury fishing grounds.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2012–2020年捕捞记录、AIS渔船作业时长、船籍数据及夜间灯光（NTL）遥感观测，追踪太平洋秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）渔场东移动态，并分析其与黑潮延伸体系统（KES）水文变异的关联。NTL辐射度在表征环境驱动的渔场变动方面优于CPUE和作业时长，随机森林模型识别出混合层深度、海表盐度、浮游植物碳及海表温度（SST）为主要预测因子。结果显示2019–2020年渔场重心显著东移，且早期（5–7月）位移与年度位移高度相关，表明年度格局受早期环境条件预 conditioning。传统渔场SST位移与东移关联最强，而黑潮延伸体锋面延长及区域平均动能升高年份对应更大东移幅度，揭示早期KES水文变异通过热重组驱动渔场东向再分布。研究凸显夜间灯光遥感在追踪跨界渔业位移中的价值，并为秋刀鱼渔场近期东移提供重要海洋学背景。

papers.title: Purple sulfur bacteria convert aquaculture waste into antioxidant-rich single-cell protein through biofloc technology
papers.authors: Vahdat, Saeid; Asrami, Manizheh Biabani; Safari, Reza
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了紫色硫细菌（purple sulfur bacteria）通过生物絮团技术（biofloc technology）将水产养殖废弃物转化为富含抗氧化剂的单细胞蛋白的可行性。研究重点在于评估该生物转化过程的效率及产物营养价值，为养殖废弃物资源化利用提供新途径。结果表明，该技术可同步实现废弃物减量与高价值蛋白生产，具有在水产饲料中替代传统蛋白源的潜力。

papers.title: Smart Technology and Innovation in Seaweed Aquaculture: A Global Bibliometric and Scientometric Review
papers.authors: Nelyne Lourdes Y. Plaza
papers.journal: Journal of Intelligent Decision Making and Information Science
papers.abstract: Smart technology and innovation have become increasingly important in transforming seaweed aquaculture into a more sustainable, efficient, and data-driven industry. This study conducted a global bibliometric and scientometric review to examine research trends, technological developments, collaboration networks, and emerging scientific directions related to smart seaweed aquaculture. Bibliographic data were retrieved from the Scopus database using a structured search string covering technologies such as Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), automation, remote sensing, blockchain, machine learning, and digital monitoring systems. The collected datasets were analyzed using RStudio through the Bibliometrix package and visualized using VOSviewer for network mapping and thematic analysis. Findings revealed a continuous increase in scientific publications, particularly after 2015, indicating growing global interest in precision aquaculture and sustainable marine resource management. The results identified China, India, Indonesia, and the United States as leading contributors in terms of research productivity and international collaboration. Keyword co-occurrence and thematic evolution analyses demonstrated the increasing integration of AI, IoT, automation, environmental monitoring, and sustainability-focused technologies within seaweed farming systems. Scientometric clustering further highlighted the interdisciplinary nature of the field, combining marine science, environmental studies, biotechnology, and digital innovation. The study also identified research gaps associated with technological accessibility, collaboration disparities, and sustainable implementation in developing regions. Overall, the findings confirm that smart technologies are playing a transformative role in advancing seaweed aquaculture toward more intelligent, climate-resilient, and sustainable production systems globally.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过全球文献计量与科学计量分析，系统梳理了智慧海藻养殖领域的研究趋势、技术发展、合作网络及新兴方向。基于Scopus数据库检索，运用Bibliometrix和VOSviewer工具分析发现，2015年后相关发文量持续增长，中国、印度、印尼和美国为主要贡献者。关键词共现与主题演化显示，AI、IoT、自动化及环境监测技术正加速整合于海藻养殖系统，但技术可及性和区域合作差异仍是主要研究缺口。研究证实智慧技术正推动海藻养殖向智能化、气候韧性和可持续生产转型。

papers.title: Smart Technologies for Aquaculture: A Global Bibliometric Analysis of Digital Innovation, Knowledge Structures, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Lyndon A. Rosas, Sharon A. Bucalon
papers.journal: Journal of Intelligent Decision Making and Information Science
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of digital technologies has transformed aquaculture into a data-driven industry, yet the expanding body of research on smart technologies remains fragmented across multiple scientific disciplines. Despite increasing interest in intelligent aquaculture systems, a comprehensive understanding of the field's global development, knowledge structure, and emerging research directions remains limited. This study addresses this gap through a bibliometric analysis of 7,197 English-language publications indexed in the Scopus database from 1976 to 2026. Bibliographic data were analyzed using the Bibliometrix package in RStudio and VOSviewer to evaluate scientific growth, research productivity, collaboration networks, conceptual structure, thematic evolution, and future research directions. The results reveal accelerated scientific expansion over the past decade, driven by a relatively concentrated group of influential journals, researchers, institutions, and countries, with China emerging as the leading contributor to both scientific production and international collaboration. Collaboration network analysis demonstrates an increasingly interconnected global research community, while keyword co-occurrence and thematic evolution analyses reveal a clear transition from sensor-based environmental monitoring toward integrated applications of the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, and remote sensing for intelligent aquaculture management. Emerging themes further indicate growing attention to sustainability, predictive analytics, and autonomous decision-support systems. By synthesizing nearly five decades of scientific development, this study provides a comprehensive knowledge map of smart aquaculture research, identifies strategic research opportunities, and offers evidence-based guidance for researchers, policymakers, and technology developers advancing sustainable digital transformation within the global aquaculture sector.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过文献计量学方法，系统分析了1976至2026年间Scopus数据库中7,197篇英文文献，揭示了智慧水产养殖领域的全球发展态势、知识结构与研究前沿。结果显示，近十年该领域科研产出加速增长，中国在产量与国际合作中居领先地位，研究主题正从传感器环境监测转向物联网、人工智能、机器学习及计算机视觉的集成应用，并日益关注可持续性与自主决策系统。研究为渔业研究者、政策制定者及技术开发者提供了全面的知识图谱与战略方向参考。

papers.title: A self-training approach to improve multispecies school classification models in fisheries acoustics data
papers.authors: Lekanda, Aitor; Boyra, Guillermo; Handegard, Nils Olav; Louzao, Maite
papers.abstract: Abstract Automatic classification models of pelagic species based on trawl–acoustic survey data link echotrace characteristics observed in echosounder echograms to species caught in pelagic trawl hauls. In multispecies ecosystems, developing such models is particularly challenging because pelagic trawls provide probabilistic, proportion‑based species information rather than unambiguous labels for individual schools, which limits the applicability of strictly supervised training and motivates weakly-supervised (probabilistic) learning approaches. This study aims to improve the performance of a previously developed weakly-supervised multi-output classification model through a conservative self-training technique. Using the model’s probabilistic multispecies outputs, self-training gradually transforms the most confident predictions among the poorly-labelled cases into pseudo-labelled ones, increasing the ratio of labelled data and strengthening both model learning and evaluation for the next iterations. The approach was tested on a multi-output classification model trained on small pelagic species in the Bay of Biscay. Self-training improved overall out-of-sample accuracy from 63.5% to 72% (F1-score from 53.7% to 60.7%), maintaining or improving performance for each individual species. Notably, it substantially enhanced performance for species that are abundant but rarely captured in monospecific trawls, such as sardine, whose accuracy increased from 50% to 86% (F1-score from 27.3% to 52.7%). In contrast, performance for species with enough labelled cases remained stable throughout the process.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种保守自训练方法，以提升多物种声学数据中鱼类学校分类模型的性能。该方法基于拖网-声学调查数据，利用弱监督多输出模型，逐步将低置信度样本转化为伪标签，增加标记数据比例。在比斯开湾小型中上层鱼类测试中，总体样本外准确率从63.5%提升至72%，F1分数从53.7%升至60.7%，其中沙丁鱼等丰度高但单种拖网捕获少的物种准确率从50%增至86%。该方法有效增强稀有标签物种的分类性能，同时保持其他物种稳定性。

papers.title: An intelligent autonomous floating net cage system for water quality management based on adaptive repositioning in aquaculture environments
papers.authors: Suprapto, Bhakti Yudho; Dwijayanti, Suci; Okta Setiawan, I Ketut; Irmawan, Irmawan; Arifin, Bustanul; Wai Yie, Leong
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于自适应重定位的智能自主浮式网箱系统，用于水产养殖环境中的水质管理。系统通过动态调整网箱位置以优化水质条件，旨在提升养殖效率和可持续性。该系统集成智能控制技术，适用于开放水域养殖场景。

papers.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly of three Sparidae fish genomes (goldlined seabream Rhabdosargus sarba, blackhead seabream Acanthopagrus schlegelii, and crimson seabream Evynnis cardinalis) using PacBio and Hi-C sequencing technologies
papers.authors: Zhu, Kecheng; Liu, Baosuo; Guo, Huayang; Zhang, Nan; Zhang, Dianchang
papers.abstract: Abstract Rhabdosargus sarba , Acanthopagrus schlegelii , and Evynnis cardinalis are representative Sparidae fish in the northern South China Sea. In the past century, these species have become economically important marine fishery species in the western Pacific region. Although they are economically very important fish species, high-quality genetic maps for germplasm resource evaluation research are lacking. With the use of PacBio and Hi-C sequencing technologies, the chromosome-level genomes of R. sarba , A. schlegelii , and E. cardinalis were constructed. The final assembly sizes of R. sarba , A. schlegelii , and E. cardinalis were 731.5 Mb, 701.7 Mb, and 736.7 Mb, respectively, with contig N50 values of 6.6 Mb, 16.4 Mb, and 6.9 Mb, respectively. Moreover, 99.75%, 99.11%, and 98.87% of these three Sparidae fish genome sequences on 24 chromosomes with total lengths of 729.6 Mb, 695.5 Mb, and 728.4 Mb, respectively, were successfully anchored. In addition, the average chromosome lengths of these three Sparidae fishes were 30.4 Mb, 29.0 Mb, and 30.3 Mb, respectively. A total of 207.8 Mb, 187.0 Mb, and 205.8 Mb of interspersed repeats and 21,674, 22,011, and 21,915 protein-coding genes were annotated in the genomes of R. sarba , A. schlegelii , and E. cardinalis , respectively. The genomes of these three Sparidae fish species will provide a theoretical foundation not only for facilitating comparative genomic studies but also for genetic breeding programs for the three Sparidae species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用PacBio和Hi-C测序技术，构建了三种鲷科鱼类（金线鲷、黑头鲷和绯鲷）的染色体水平基因组，组装大小分别为731.5 Mb、701.7 Mb和736.7 Mb，contig N50达6.6–16.4 Mb，并将98.87%–99.75%的序列锚定至24条染色体。基因组注释鉴定出21,674–22,011个蛋白编码基因及大量散在重复序列。这些高质量基因组为三种鲷科鱼类的比较基因组学研究和遗传育种计划提供了重要基础。

papers.title: The Potential of Biscuit with Fish Protein Hydrolysate as an Alternative Protein Source Snack for Toddlers
papers.authors: Ganggi, Salsabila Mega Kencono; Syauqy, Ahmad; Anjani, Gemala; Ayustaningwarno, Fitriyono; Rusyanto, Widya; Afifah, Diana Nur
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了添加鱼蛋白水解物（Fish Protein Hydrolysate）的饼干作为幼儿替代蛋白零食的潜力。通过分析不同添加比例对饼干营养组成、蛋白质含量及感官接受度的影响，评估其作为营养强化食品的可行性。结果显示，适量添加鱼蛋白水解物可显著提升饼干蛋白质品质，同时保持可接受的感官特性，为改善幼儿蛋白质摄入不足提供了新途径。

papers.authors: Konoyima, Komba Jossie; Mansaray, Amidu
papers.abstract: Abstract Ethmalosa fimbriata , a key small pelagic species underpinning food security and livelihoods along the West African coast, warrants a robust stock assessment due to concerns of overexploitation. This study synthesizes multi‐fleet catch records (1970–2021) and unstandardized catch per unit effort (CPUE) data (1995–2017) from the Eastern Central Atlantic (ECAO) to evaluate the northern stock using four surplus production models: the catch‐only (CMSY) and abundance‐only (AMSY) maximum sustainable yield models, the Bayesian state‐space model (BSM) and the Just Another Bayesian Biomass Assessment (JABBA) model implementing Schaefer, Fox and Pella‐Tomlinson functions. The objective was to evaluate model predictive accuracy and stock status to provide evidence‐based management advice. From the results, CMSY indicated 2021 biomass (B) was marginally above the sustainable limit (B/BMSY ≈ 1.03) with current fishing mortality (F) near FMSY, while AMSY and BSM both indicated ongoing depletion (B/BMSY ≈ 0.56–0.81) and overfishing (F/FMSY >1.0). JABBA's Schaefer model, demonstrating superior fit (root‐mean‐square error = 16.9%, Deviance Information Criterion = −382.7) over Fox and Pella‐Tomlinson models, estimated 2021 biomass at 9% below BMSY and fishing mortality at 59% above FMSY. Fox and Pella‐Tomlinson models yielded similar biomass trajectories but were less precautionary. Projections indicate that only Schaefer‐based total allowable catches (TACs) below 100,000 t would stabilize biomass; higher quotas risk continued decline. Despite limitations including incomplete catch data and reliance on unstandardized indices, results underscore the urgency for precautionary catch limits, regional coordination and improved compliance to ensure sustainability. This study offers a transferable assessment framework for data‐limited fisheries and supports evidence‐based policy for the conservation of E. fimbriata and food‐security resilience in West Africa.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对西非水域关键小型中上层鱼类Bonga Shad（Ethmalosa fimbriata）因过度捕捞引发的资源衰退问题，整合1970–2021年多船队捕捞记录及1995–2017年未标准化CPUE数据，运用四种 surplus production 模型（CMSY、AMSY、BSM及JABBA）进行多模型贝叶斯资源评估。结果显示，JABBA的Schaefer模型拟合最优，估计2021年生物量低于BMSY的9%，捕捞死亡率高于FMSY的59%，表明资源处于过度捕捞状态；而CMSY结果偏乐观，Fox和Pella-Tomlinson模型则预警性不足。预测表明，仅当基于Schaefer模型的总可捕量（TAC）低于100,000吨时才能稳定生物量，否则资源将持续衰退。研究强调亟需采取预防性捕捞限额、加强区域协调与执法，并提供了适用于数据有限渔业的可转移评估框架。

papers.title: CORRECTION: Community structure of southern California’s subtidal rocky reefs and implications for artificial reef design
papers.authors: Kitchel, Zoë J.; Claisse, Jeremy T.; Pondella, Dan; Williams, Chelsea M.; Williams, Jonathan P.; Schroeder, Donna M.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在探讨南加州潮下带岩礁的群落结构，并为人工鱼礁设计提供参考依据。通过分析自然岩礁的物种组成与空间分布，揭示了群落多样性与环境因子的关联，进而提出优化人工鱼礁布局以增强生态功能的建议。研究结果对区域渔业资源管理和栖息地修复具有直接指导意义。

papers.authors: Koopman, Natalie C.; Hardie, David C.; Lennox, Robert J.; Piczak, Morgan L.; Whoriskey, Frederick G.; Brunsdon, Eric B.; Hutchings, Jeffrey A.; Crossin, Glenn T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Significant declines in Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ) populations across their range have prompted an increased use of hatchery supplementation programmes to support population recovery. However, concerns persist regarding the effectiveness of these programmes due to limited understanding of how hatchery‐reared salmon perform post‐release in natural river systems compared to their wild counterparts. This study examined survival, predation risk, migration speed, river exit timing and early ocean migration patterns of hatchery‐reared and wild Atlantic salmon smolts in the LaHave River, Nova Scotia, where populations are among the most dramatically reduced in Canada. Using acoustic telemetry, we tracked the movements of 100 smolts (50 hatchery origin, 50 wild origin) during their freshwater downstream migration and into the ocean. Compared to wild smolts, hatchery smolts exhibited significantly lower survival during river outmigration, with a third dying before reaching lower river sections. Predation was a major driver of mortality, with hatchery smolts experiencing over four times higher predation risk than wild smolts following release. Hatchery smolts had significantly slower migration speeds in the upper river and lake sections, and they also exhibited significantly greater reverse movements near the head of tide compared to wild smolts. However, river exit timing and early ocean migration routes were comparable between smolts' origins, indicating potential synchrony and environmental cue retention for hatchery smolts. Critical empirical evidence of early marine migration for the salmon population was captured, with both hatchery and wild smolts following the expected eastward migration along the southern coast of Nova Scotia. Taken together, these results indicate that hatchery smolts experience higher predation risk and less efficient migration than wild smolts, likely due to predator naivety and captive rearing conditions. This study also identified a predation hotspot in Wentzells Lake, the one lake smolts migrate through during river exit, highlighting an opportunity to increase smolt survival by releasing hatchery smolts downstream of high‐risk predation areas. Implementing targeted release strategies and innovative captive rearing conditions may help mitigate post‐release challenges for hatchery smolts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究追踪了加拿大LaHave River中人工孵化和野生大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）幼鱼的河流出口及早期海洋迁移，以评估其存活率、捕食风险和迁移速度。通过声学遥测标记100尾幼鱼（各50尾），发现人工孵化幼鱼在河流下行迁移中存活率显著低于野生个体，且捕食风险高出4倍以上，迁移速度在上游和湖区明显较慢。两群体在河流出口时间和早期海洋迁移路线上无显著差异，均沿新斯科舍南部海岸东向迁移。研究识别出Wentzells Lake为捕食热点区域，建议在风险区下游释放人工孵化幼鱼，并改进圈养条件以提升其野外适应能力。

papers.title: The Role of Fisheries Sector in The Economy of Bontang City
papers.authors: Chairullah Amin; Erwan Sulistianto
papers.abstract: Bontang City is a coastal city in East Kalimantan Province with significant fisheries and marine potential. Its marine ecosystems include mangrove forests, coral reefs, seagrass beds, and diverse marine biodiversity. This study aims to examine the role of the fisheries sector in the economic structure of Bontang City during the period 2016–2025. The data were analyzed using the Location Quotient (LQ) method. The results indicate that, during the 2016–2025 period, the fisheries sector has not yet become a basic sector in the economy of Bontang City. The LQ values ranged from 0.54 to 0.71, indicating that although the sector experienced income growth, its contribution to the regional economy of Bontang City remains relatively limited.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印度尼西亚东加里曼丹省沿海城市Bontang为对象，采用Location Quotient (LQ)方法分析2016–2025年渔业部门在经济结构中的作用。结果显示，该时期渔业LQ值介于0.54–0.71，表明渔业尚未成为当地基础经济部门，尽管收入有所增长，但对区域经济的贡献仍相对有限。

papers.title: Mito‐Nuclear Discordance and Species Boundaries in the Freshwater Fish Genus Cyprinion Revealed by Genome‐Wide SNPs
papers.authors: Hashemzadeh Segherloo, Iraj; Geiger, Matthias F.; Normandeau, Eric; Freyhof, Jörg
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The cyprinid genus Cyprinion , comprising nine species distributed from the Indus drainage across the Iranian Plateau to Mesopotamia and the Arabian Peninsula, exhibits contentious species boundaries due to extensive morphological overlap and limited molecular data. In this study, we integrated mitochondrial DNA ( COI ) sequences and genome‐wide single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data to investigate the phylogenetic relationships, taxonomy, and biogeography of six species: C. acinaces , C. kais , C. macrostomum , C. microphthalmum , C. mhalense , and C. muscatense . Mitochondrial analyses revealed extremely shallow divergence among C. macrostomum , C. kais , C. acinaces , and C. tenuiradius , sharing identical or closely related haplotypes. In contrast, genome‐wide SNP analyses resolved most taxa as distinct genomic clusters. Clustering and gene‐flow analyses identified five major genetic groups and revealed patterns consistent with historical introgression, particularly between C. macrostomum and C. acinaces . Despite shallow mitochondrial divergence, genome‐wide SNP analyses revealed differentiation among several taxa, providing preliminary support for lineage divergence. However, these interpretations remain constrained by limited genomic sampling, and alternative explanations including incomplete lineage sorting cannot be excluded. Our results further refine biogeographic hypotheses for Cyprinion species, suggesting that recent dispersal and historical connectivity among Mesopotamian, Iranian, and Arabian drainages may have been facilitated by palaeodrainage systems active during the Late Pleistocene. In addition, analysis of unpublished GenBank COI sequences suggests that C. tenuiradius , previously considered restricted to northern Persian Gulf drainages, may also occur on the Arabian Peninsula. This study provides the first genomic framework for understanding the taxonomy and biogeography of Cyprinion in western Asia.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究利用线粒体COI序列和全基因组SNP数据，对淡水鱼类Cyprinion属6个种的系统发育、分类和生物地理学进行了整合分析。线粒体数据显示C. macrostomum、C. kais、C. acinaces和C. tenuiradius间分化极浅，而SNP分析则将多数分类单元解析为独立基因组簇，并识别出5个主要遗传类群及历史基因渐渗信号。尽管线粒体分化有限，基因组证据初步支持谱系分化，但受采样限制，不完全谱系分选等替代解释尚无法排除。研究还提出更新世晚期古水系促进了美索不达米亚、伊朗和阿拉伯流域间的扩散连通，并发现C. tenuiradius可能扩展分布至阿拉伯半岛，为Cyprinion属分类与生物地理提供了首个基因组框架。

papers.title: Diel release timing is a critical determinant of reef fish survival in Post‐larval Capture, Culture, and Release
papers.authors: Gojanovic, Alan; Kelley, Jennifer L.; Brooker, Rohan M.; Price, Nathan W.; Depczynski, Martial; Holmes, Thomas H.; Hemmi, Jan M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Predation is a dominant force shaping survival of coral reef fishes. Synchronous, nocturnal settlement during low‐light, new moon periods may have developed as an adaptive response to intense predation during settlement. Post‐larval Capture, Culture, and Release (PCCR), where juvenile fishes are released directly to the reef, effectively modifies the timing and conditions of settlement, potentially reducing high predation‐induced mortality during settlement. Without targeted refinement of its protocols, PCCR may fail to confer survival benefits over natural settlement. Understanding how factors such as diel release timing shape post‐release survival is therefore essential for improving restoration outcomes. Objective This study aimed to test how diel release timing influences behavior, predation exposure, and early post‐release survival of a coral reef fish ( Pomacentrus amboinensis ) under short‐term PCCR. Methods Fish were captured before settlement and individually released onto experimental patch reefs at either 09:00 or 17:00 hours following a 4‐ to 5‐day rearing period, adjusted to ensure equal average age at release. Post‐release behavior was quantified, survival monitored over 48 hours, and interval‐specific mortality rates modelled to examine the role of release timing on PCCR outcomes. Results Fish released in the morning survived significantly better than fish released in the afternoon. Predation was highest in the immediate post‐release period regardless of release timing, but worse for afternoon releases, creating a survival gap that persisted across the 48‐hour monitoring period. Conclusion We identify diel release timing as an important determinant of PCCR success. Releasing fish at a time of day that maximized experience acquisition enhanced post‐release survival.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了日释放时间对珊瑚礁鱼类（Pomacentrus amboinensis）在Post-larval Capture, Culture, and Release（PCCR）过程中存活率的影响。通过将幼鱼在09:00或17:00释放至实验性斑块礁，并监测48小时存活率，发现早晨释放的鱼类存活率显著高于下午释放。捕食压力在释放后立即最高，但下午释放的存活劣势持续存在。研究确定日释放时间是PCCR成功的关键决定因素，优化释放时间以增强经验获取可提升放流后存活率。

papers.title: Arctic project competitiveness components: fish and seafood extraction and production
papers.authors: Vopilovskiy, S. S.
papers.abstract: This study examines current issues related to the development of an effective system for promoting competition in the fishing industry in Russia’s Arctic zone. Through the implementation of key components of fisheries management - fish harvesting (catching) and production of fish and seafood. An analysis of the development of authorized quotas in the Northern Fisheries Basin in 2025 revealed a change in the catch structure: the share of cod in the total catch decreased to 50.5%, compared to 61% the previous year; the share of haddock and Atlantic herring increased. The study identifies the conditions for implementing federal and national projects aimed at strategically developing the industry and meeting the needs of the Arctic region’s population with a variety of fish products. It was revealed that indicators of production of goods and services and the financial condition of organizations by types of economic activity - fishing and fish farming - determine a more stable competitive position of the fishing industry in the Arctic zone of Russia in relation to other areas of activity significant for the region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨俄罗斯北极地区渔业竞争促进体系的发展问题，聚焦鱼类捕捞及海产品生产两大管理核心。对2025年北方渔业盆地授权配额的分析显示，捕捞结构发生变化：鳕鱼占比从上年61%降至50.5%，黑线鳕和大西洋鲱鱼份额上升。研究明确了实施联邦及国家项目的条件，旨在推动产业战略发展并满足北极居民多样化水产品需求。结果表明，渔业及水产养殖业在商品服务生产和组织财务状况指标上，较区域其他重要经济活动更具稳定竞争优势。

papers.authors: Ghosh, Nabanita; Roy, Monalisha; Bhattacharyya, Dipak Kumar
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The term “Ready‐to‐Eat Breakfast Cereal” refers especially to the processed grain formulations suitable for human consumption without requiring further preparation to save time. It is easy to store, relatively shelf‐stable, and lightweight. A significant proportion of them are made with corn, wheat, oats, and rice, with added flavors and fortifications. In this work, an attempt was made to utilize the rich antioxidative blend of fish skin oil (FSO) and chia seed oil (CO). Four formulations were prepared using four different chia seed flour, namely, raw chia seed flour breakfast cereal (RCB), defatted chia seed flour breakfast cereal (DCB), raw roasted chia flour breakfast cereal (RRCB), and roasted defatted chia flour breakfast cereal (RDCB). All the physicochemical tests were satisfactory for each formulation. Among the four formulations, RRCB is liked mostly in hedonic rating test for sensory evaluation by the panel members. Breakfast cereals are sold as milled grains of different cereals that required further cooking or no cooking prior to consumption. Breakfast plays an important role in everyday diet plan as it is the first food that we took after the dinner of previous day. So, breakfast meal should be rich in all nutrients to fulfill the needs till the lunch time. Nowadays, due to busy schedules, attention is moved toward ready‐to‐eat breakfast items rather than the traditional one.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用鱼皮（Labeo rohita）与奇亚籽油（Salvia hispanica）的抗氧化复合物，结合全脂及改性奇亚籽粉和鱼皮蛋白分离物，开发富含蛋白质的即食早餐谷物产品。通过四种配方（生奇亚籽粉、脱脂奇亚籽粉、生烤奇亚籽粉、烤脱脂奇亚籽粉）的理化测试，所有配方均达标，其中生烤奇亚籽粉配方（RRCB）在感官评价中获最高偏好评分。研究旨在满足现代快节奏生活对营养便捷早餐的需求，为渔业副产物高值化利用提供新途径。

papers.title: Microbial Contamination and Insect Pest Infestation of Traditionally Smoked Fish Sold in Selected Markets in Makurdi, Nigeria: Implications for Post-harvest Quality and Food Safety
papers.authors: Aende, Athanasius Aondohemen; Solomon, Achussah Terwase; Jude, Amile Tersoo; Ibagye, Oshimagye Michael; Umma, Samuel Bem; Torsabo, Donald
papers.journal: European Journal of Nutrition & Food Safety
papers.abstract: This study investigated microbial contamination and insect pest infestation in smoked fish sourced from Wurukum and Wadata, two major retail fish markets in Makurdi, the capital of Benue State. Smoked fish remains an accessible source of animal protein in Nigerian markets; however, species-level characterisation of simultaneous microbial contamination and insect infestation during open-market storage remains a critical post-harvest knowledge gap. Three commercially important species (Protopterus annectens, Oreochromis niloticus, and Clarias gariepinus) were purchased and sealed in polyethylene bags for transport to the laboratory. Total viable count (TVC), total coliform count (TCC), and total fungal count (TFC) were assessed using standard pour-plate methods, and isolates were identified through Gram staining, biochemical tests, and morphological characterisation. Protopterus annectens from Wurukum recorded the highest TVC (2.06 × 10² ± 2.00 cfu/g) and TCC (75.00 ± 1.00 cfu/g), whereas Oreochromis niloticus from Wadata yielded the highest TFC (70.50 ± 2.50 cfu/g). Clarias gariepinus showed the lowest TCC values in both markets. Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp., and Bacillus spp. were detected in all fish-market combinations; Mucor, Rhizopus, and Fusarium were confined to Clarias gariepinus; and Streptococcus spp. occurred only in Protopterus annectens. Dermestes maculatus was the predominant insect pest, with the highest mean infestation recorded in Protopterus annectens from Wadata (17.13 ± 6.86). Significant differences (P < 0.05) across all parameters indicate the need for improved smoking practices, hygienic storage, and integrated post-harvest pest management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚马库尔迪两个主要零售市场（Wurukum和Wadata）中传统烟熏鱼的微生物污染与害虫侵染情况，旨在填补开放市场储存期间同步评估微生物与昆虫污染的知识空白。对三种商业重要鱼类（Protopterus annectens、Oreochromis niloticus和Clarias gariepinus）进行了总活菌数（TVC）、总大肠菌群数（TCC）和总真菌数（TFC）测定，并通过革兰氏染色、生化测试及形态学鉴定分离菌株。结果显示，Wurukum市场的P. annectens具有最高TVC（2.06 × 10² ± 2.00 cfu/g）和TCC（75.00 ± 1.00 cfu/g），而Wadata市场的O. niloticus TFC最高（70.50 ± 2.50 cfu/g）；Klebsiella spp.、Proteus spp.和Bacillus spp.在所有样品中检出，Dermestes maculatus为主要害虫，最高侵染率见于Wadata市场的P. annectens（17.13 ± 6.86）。各参数差异显著（P < 0.05），表明需改进烟熏工艺、加强卫生储存并实施综合采后害虫管理。

papers.title: Group Dynamics Of The “Mina Muda Makmur” Fish Farmers Group In Lempake Sub- District, North Samarinda District, Samarinda City
papers.authors: Huda, Muhamad Syamsul; Said Abdusysyahid; Oon Darmansyah
papers.abstract: Lempake is one of eight sub-districts in North Samarinda District, Samarinda City, with considerable potential for freshwater aquaculture. Local communities utilise public water resources through earthen ponds and tarpaulin ponds, with the latter commonly established on residential land. Initially, fish farming activities were carried out individually. However, farmers later recognised the importance of establishing a fish farmer group (Pokdakan) to strengthen cooperation, improve knowledge sharing, and fulfil administrative requirements for obtaining government assistance from the Samarinda City Fisheries Department. Consequently, in 2022, with support from the department, the “Mina Muda Makmur Fish Farmers Group” was officially established. This study is meant to explain who the Mina Muda Makmur Fish Farmers Group and analyse its level of group dynamics. A qualitative descriptive approach was employed using survey methods. The research utilised both primary and secondary data were gathered using observation, interviews, documentation, and relevant literature. The findings reveal that the Mina Muda Makmur Fish Farmers Group was established on 28 December 2022 and officially recognised by the Samarinda City Department of Fisheries and Marine Affairs in the same year. The group consists of 11 members, including a chairperson, secretary, treasurer, supervisor, and members. The group cultivates catfish (Clarias batrachus) and gourami (Osphronemus goramy), while marketing its products through collectors and social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. As a beginner-level fish farmer group, Mina Muda Makmur demonstrated a Highly Dynamic level of group dynamics, indicating effective cooperation, participation, communication, and organisational performance among its members.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印度尼西亚三马林达市Lempake区的“Mina Muda Makmur”鱼农团体为对象，采用定性描述与调查方法，旨在解析其组织结构并评估群体动态水平。该团体成立于2022年，由11名成员组成，主要养殖catfish（Clarias batrachus）和gourami（Osphronemus goramy），并通过中间商及社交媒体销售。结果显示，作为初级鱼农团体，其群体动态被评为“高度活跃”，成员间在合作、参与、沟通及组织绩效方面表现优异。

papers.title: Lumpfish as a cleaner for Atlantic salmon: a review of the method and assessment of prospects for its implementation in Russian aquaculture
papers.authors: Rusyaev, S. M.; Bakay, Yu. I.
papers.abstract: The intensive development of global commercial salmon farming has led to the emergence of a number of technologies, among which the use of cleaner fish to combat parasitic infestations stands out. Such a type of fish in mariculture has become the lumpfish Cyclopterus lumpus , whose individuals, when grown together, tend to eat ectoparasitic crustaceans from the body surface of Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ). This review examines the achievements of the foreign fisheries sector in the cultivation of cleaner lumpfish and its further joint maintenance with Atlantic salmon in marine cages. An indicative indicator of the effectiveness of the introduction of such biotechnology into commercial salmon farming has been obtained. The recommended production volume of lumpfish for Russian mariculture in the Kola North has been calculated. It is pointed out that it is necessary to take into account climate changes in this Arctic region and choose a way to implement this method in the current geopolitical conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了圆鳍鱼（*Cyclopterus lumpus*）作为清洁鱼控制大西洋鲑（*Salmo salar*）体表寄生甲壳类的技术方法，评估其在俄罗斯水产养殖中的应用前景。通过分析国外海水网箱混养实践，获得了该生物技术引入商业鲑鱼养殖的有效性指标，并计算了摩尔曼斯克北部（Kola North）俄罗斯海水养殖的推荐圆鳍鱼生产规模。研究指出需考虑该北极地区气候变化影响，并在当前地缘政治条件下选择适宜的实施路径。

papers.title: Development of a ROS Bridge Communication Framework for Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring in Aquaculture Floating Net Cages
papers.authors: Suprapto, Bhakti Yudho; Pratama, Ilham; Azim, Muhammad Rafian; Dwijayanti, Suci
papers.journal: International Journal of Electronics and Telecommunications
papers.abstract: Conventional floating net cages (KJA), widely used in aquaculture, generally lack integrated water quality sensors and real-time monitoring systems, resulting in inadequate water quality management and undetected causes of fish mortality. This study addresses this gap by equipping KJA with sensors that continuously monitor key water quality parameters, temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen, and transmit data directly to a centralized server for real-time analysis and visualization via a web-based platform. To achieve fast and reliable wireless communication between the buoy and net cage, the TCP/IP protocol is implemented within the Robot Operating System (ROS) framework. This enables seamless interfacing of non-ROS devices, such as ESP32 microcontrollers, with the ROS system hosted on a laptop, facilitating rapid and stable data transfer. System performance tests under varying network conditions, server loads, and user access showed average data transmission delays of approximately 1 second, with maximum delays ranging from 4 to 9 seconds. Additional TCP/IP communication tests revealed an average packet delivery latency of just 11 milliseconds, demonstrating the high efficiency of the wireless link. User experience evaluation found that 90% of participants rated the web interface as both easy to use and informative, receiving an overall “excellent” usability score. These findings confirm that the developed system significantly improves the effectiveness of realtime water quality monitoring in KJA operations, potentially reducing fish mortality caused by water quality issues.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对水产养殖浮式网箱（KJA）缺乏集成水质传感器和实时监测系统的问题，开发了一套基于ROS Bridge的通信框架，通过ESP32微控制器持续监测温度、pH和溶解氧，并利用TCP/IP协议将数据实时传输至中央服务器进行网络平台可视化分析。系统性能测试显示，平均数据传输延迟约1秒，最大延迟4-9秒，TCP/IP通信平均包延迟仅11毫秒，且90%用户评价界面易用且信息丰富。结果表明该系统显著提升了KJA水质监测效率，有望降低因水质问题导致的鱼类死亡率。

papers.title: Organization of the educational process for training personnel in the field of aquaculture at Murmansk Arctic University
papers.authors: Kravets, P. P.; Abrashkina, A. V.; Ivanova, A. V.; Mitina, E. G.; Makeenko, G. A.; Abrashkin, A. V.
papers.abstract: The article presents a comprehensive approach to the training of students in the field of “Water Bioresources and Aquaculture” at the Murmansk Arctic University. The use of material and technical equipment at the Department of Biology and Bioresources is aimed at creating conditions for students to develop practical skills that are in demand in the future during various types of practice, conducting research, and finding employment. Students’ participation in acceleration programs and competitions at various levels contributes to the development of entrepreneurial skills in future specialists in the field of aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本文介绍了摩尔曼斯克北极大学在水产养殖领域人才培养的教学组织方案，重点阐述了该专业学生通过生物与生物资源系的物质技术设备培养实践技能，并参与加速计划和各级竞赛以提升创业能力。研究旨在为水产养殖专业学生未来就业和科研奠定基础。

papers.title: Chemometric search for IR spectral characteristics associated with the level of antiradical activity of food ingredients and feed for aquaculture
papers.authors: Gorbachev, V. V.; Smirnov, A. A.; Belyaeva, M. A.; Lyutikov, A. A.; Suslov, D. V.
papers.abstract: The paper provides data on the assessment and search of spectral characteristics of the mid-IR range using chemometric analysis methods, as well as the search for diagnostically associated spectral regions that statistically correlate with the values of increased antiradical activity for food components and ingredients used in the production of feed in aquaculture. The study included such commonly used food additives as tocopherol (vitamin E), ascorbic acid, as well as hydrocolloids: gum arabic (E414), guar gum (E412), konjac gum (E425), structure-forming agents isolated from edible algae species: agar-agar (E406), alginate (E401), κ-, λ-, ι--carrageenans (E407). For each of the studied groups of compounds, in addition to its spectral IR characteristics, an analysis was performed to determine the antiradical activity, which was measured photocolorimetrically by using the stable radical DPPH. The presented data are very relevant for the development of a mathematical model that allows rapid testing of food components, food products, and ready-made feeds for aquaculture in order to assess their antiradical activity and, in the future, their shelf life.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究运用化学计量学方法分析中红外光谱特征，旨在识别与水产养殖饲料及食品成分抗自由基活性相关的诊断性光谱区域。研究对象包括生育酚、抗坏血酸及多种亲水胶体（如阿拉伯胶、瓜尔胶、卡拉胶等），并采用DPPH法光比色测定各化合物的抗自由基活性。结果显示特定红外波段与抗自由基活性存在统计相关性，为开发快速评估饲料及食品抗氧化能力及货架期的数学模型提供了基础数据。

papers.title: From Genogroups to Control Strategies: A Comprehensive Review of Piscirickettsia salmonis and Piscirickettsiosis to Optimize Health Management in Salmonid Aquaculture
papers.authors: Rozas‐Serri, Marco
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Piscirickettsiosis, caused by the facultative intracellular bacterium Piscirickettsia salmonis , remains the primary infectious disease economically limiting salmonid aquaculture in Chile, while its incidence has also increased in farmed salmonids in Ireland, Scotland, Australia, and Canada in recent years. This comprehensive review synthesizes 181 peer‐reviewed publications (2014–2026) to integrate transformative advances in P. salmonis genomics, pathogenesis, epidemiology, host immunity, and control strategies, updating the foundational 2014 review by Rozas and Enríquez. Comparative genomic studies have consistently resolved LF‐89‐like and EM‐90‐like isolates as two distinct phylogenomic clusters, with marked differences in pan‐genome composition, lineage‐specific proteins, ribosomal operon organization, and Dot/Icm‐associated genomic architecture, supporting genogroup‐level divergence that should not be inferred from any single threshold‐based metric such as Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) alone. Genogroup‐specific disease phenotypes are also well established. LF‐89 produces chronic granulomatous infections, whereas EM‐90 causes acute hemorrhagic septicemia. Mechanistically, P. salmonis evades cell‐mediated immunity by inhibiting phagosome–lysosome fusion and suppressing MHC‐I–mediated antigen presentation, impairing CD8 + cytotoxic T‐lymphocyte priming and likely explaining the consistently low vaccine efficacy and genogroup‐restricted cross‐protection observed under field conditions. Treatment failures persist despite absent widespread acquired resistance, attributable to intracellular persistence, biofilm formation, and pharmacokinetic–pharmacodynamic mismatches. Despite exponential growth in mechanistic knowledge, a substantial translational gap persists between research findings and operational implementation. This review identifies critical priorities requiring urgent investment: genogroup‐specific bivalent vaccine development, climate‐adaptive biosecurity frameworks, molecular diagnostic standardization for real‐time genogroup surveillance, and integrated control strategies tailored to P. salmonis genomic heterogeneity.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述整合2014–2026年间181篇同行评审文献，系统阐述了Piscirickettsia salmonis的基因组学、致病机制、流行病学及防控策略。比较基因组研究明确区分LF-89与EM-90两个genogroup，二者在泛基因组、谱系特异蛋白及Dot/Icm相关基因组结构上差异显著，且呈现不同疾病表型（LF-89致慢性肉芽肿感染，EM-90致急性出血性败血症）。病原通过抑制吞噬体-溶酶体融合和MHC-I抗原呈递逃避细胞免疫，导致疫苗效力低下及交叉保护受限。当前亟需优先发展genogroup特异性二价疫苗、气候适应性生物安全框架、实时genogroup监测的分子诊断标准化，以及针对基因组异质性的综合控制策略。

papers.authors: Mishra, Binayak Prakash; Ojha, Gana Pati; Singh, Om Prakash; Devkota, Kedar
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture is an important sector for Nepal's economy and rural livelihoods, but its long‐term sustainability is increasingly threatened by climate change. Climate Smart Aquaculture (CSAq) has emerged as a promising approach for adaptation, mitigation and productivity enhancement. The present study aims to identify the factors that affect both adoption and the intensity of CSAq practices among pond fish farmers. Using a multistage random sampling procedure, 402 pond fish farmers across four districts (Kailali, Rupandehi, Bara and Morang) were interviewed in 2025 using a semi‐structured questionnaire. A Multivariate Probit model was employed to identify factors affecting the adoption of six CSAq practices, which included integrated water quality management (IWQM), improved feed (IF), agroforestry (AF), renewable energy (RE), insurance (IN) and integrated farming (INF). An Ordered Probit model was used to assess adoption intensity. Overall adoption of CSAq practices was low (30%–35% per practice). Age, education, farm size, membership in farmer groups/cooperatives, contact with extension workers, ICT use and farmers' perceptions on climate risks and benefits of CSAq significantly influenced adoption decisions. Adoption intensity was positively and significantly influenced by age ( p < 0.10), membership in farmer groups/cooperatives ( p < 0.01), contacts with extension workers ( p < 0.01), ICT use ( p < 0.01) and farm size ( p < 0.01), while farming experience ( p < 0.10) and distance to the agrovet ( p < 0.01) showed a negative influence. These findings underscore the need for integrated institutional support through strengthened extension services, farmer groups/cooperatives, digital information systems and improved input market access to promote CSAq adoption.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别影响尼泊尔池塘养鱼户采纳气候智能水产养殖（CSAq）实践及其强度的关键因素。基于2025年对四个地区402户养殖户的问卷调查，采用Multivariate Probit和Ordered Probit模型分析六种CSAq实践（如综合水质管理、改进饲料、农林业等）的采纳行为。结果显示，整体采纳率较低（每项实践30%–35%），年龄、教育、农场规模、合作社成员身份、推广服务接触、ICT使用及气候风险感知显著影响采纳决策，而采纳强度受年龄、合作社成员、推广接触、ICT使用和农场规模正向影响，养殖经验和农资店距离则呈负向作用。研究强调加强推广服务、合作社、数字信息系统和投入品市场准入对促进CSAq推广至关重要。

papers.title: The Effect of Knowledge and Technology on the Profitability of Diversified Fish Processing Businesses in Batutua Village, Rote Ndao Regency
papers.authors: Melkianus Teddison Bulan; Hory Iramaya Dilak; Harnever Imanuel Manao; Eflin Susana Sanu; Nelson Chornelius Ketti; Norsem Nehemia Malafu; Emanuel Destianus Banggut
papers.abstract: Considerable promise; nevertheless, they continued to struggle with profitability issues stemming from inadequate managerial expertise and limited technological adoption. This investigation sought to examine both the combined and individual influences of knowledge and technology on enterprise profitability, determine the predominant factor, and quantify their respective contributions. Employing a quantitative explanatory design with a saturated sampling approach encompassing 30 MSME proprietors, this research utilized multiple linear regression, F-test, t-test, and coefficient of determination as analytical tools. The findings demonstrated that knowledge and technology collectively exerted a significant impact onprofitability. When examined separately, knowledge exhibited a positive and statistically significant effect, whereas technology demonstrated a positive yet statistically insignificant effect. Knowledge emerged as the overriding variable, accounting for 38.1% of the variance in profitability. The practical implications underscored the critical need to strengthen business operators' knowledge base through targeted training in financial administration, processing methodologies, and digital marketing strategies prior to making technology investments, alongside the implementation of an integrated mentoring framework designed to maximize the profitability of fishery-based MSMEs operating in island regions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨知识与技术对印度尼西亚Rote Ndao县Batutua村多元化鱼类加工企业盈利能力的影响，采用定量解释性设计和饱和抽样法，对30家中小微企业主进行多元线性回归分析。结果显示，知识与技术联合显著影响盈利能力；知识单独具有正向显著效应，技术效应为正但不显著，其中知识为主导变量，解释盈利能力的38.1%变异。研究建议优先通过财务管理、加工方法和数字营销培训强化经营者知识基础，再投资技术，并配套综合指导框架以提升岛屿地区渔业中小微企业盈利能力。

papers.title: Forecasting fatty acid profiles of minced fish products
papers.authors: Vasyukova, A. T.; Edwards, A. R.; Myachikova, N. I.; Portnov, N. M.; Vasilievich, N. V.
papers.abstract: The objective of this research was to develop minced fish products based on comprehensive modeling of recipes using fish and plant-based raw materials, ensuring optimal functional and technological characteristics. Fish products are characterized by complex fatty acid compositions. The presence of double bonds in fatty acids determines their binding and technological functions. Balancing omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids is an important factor. Therefore, research aimed at optimizing the fatty acid composition of food products is relevant. The subjects of the study were ocean fish, legumes, and herbs, as well as model fish mince mixtures and finished culinary products. Experiments and tastings were used to determine the ratios of fish raw materials and plant additives that allow for optimal protein and fat proportions in the model mince mixture. The average score was 4.7–4.9. Brief heat treatment of 12 to 15 minutes at 175-180 °C and exposure of the processed product to a steam-air space reduced weight and nutrient loss to the environment, resulting in a product with a rich flavor, rich in high-quality proteins, omega-3 PUFAs, polyphenols, vitamins, and antioxidants. Cooking does not lead to a decrease in the content of omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, and in some cases, even increases their levels. This means that they are not present in pure form in fish, but rather as part of the phospholipids of cell membranes, meaning they are tightly "packed" into binary layers and surrounded by proteins. This "packaging" promotes the degradation of long-chain fatty acids.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过综合建模优化鱼与植物原料配比，开发具有最佳功能和技术特性的鱼糜产品。采用海洋鱼类、豆类及草本植物，结合实验与感官评定确定模型鱼糜混合物中蛋白质与脂肪的适宜比例，平均评分为4.7–4.9。短时热处理（175–180°C，12–15分钟）及蒸汽空气暴露可减少重量和营养损失，成品富含优质蛋白、omega-3多不饱和脂肪酸、多酚及维生素。烹饪不降低omega-3和omega-6脂肪酸含量，部分情况下甚至增加，归因于脂肪酸以磷脂双层形式结合蛋白存在，促进长链脂肪酸降解。

papers.title: Mechanistic insights into heavy metal bioaccumulation in tropical marine macroalgae: evidence from FTIR, XPS and multivariate modelling
papers.authors: Sekaran, Manoj; Kuppusamy, Satheesh; Parthiban, Niraimathi; Panneerselvam, Sathish Kumar; Chandrasekaran, Rajasekaran; Thiagarajan, Kalaivani
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦热带海洋大型藻类对重金属的生物累积机制，通过FTIR、XPS及多元建模技术揭示其吸附与结合特征。结果表明，藻类表面官能团（如羧基、羟基）和金属离子价态变化是驱动生物累积的关键因素，多元模型有效预测了累积效率。该发现为热带海域重金属污染的生物监测与修复提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Impacts of Antandroy Migration on Water Resources, Fisheries, and Aquatic Biodiversity
papers.authors: Félicité, Rejo Fienena; Andrianantenaina Tsiory Eric
papers.abstract: Internal migration has become an important adaptation strategy to climate variability in southern Madagascar, yet its implications for natural resources remain insufficiently understood. This study investigated the impacts of Antandroy migration on water resources, fisheries, and aquatic biodiversity in the districts of Toliara I and Toliara II, Atsimo-Andrefana Region. A mixed-methods approach was employed, combining quantitative and qualitative data collected from 150 respondents through structured questionnaires, semi-structured interviews, field observations, and documentary review. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, while qualitative information was examined through thematic analysis. The findings reveal that migration is primarily driven by recurrent drought, food insecurity, and limited livelihood opportunities in the Androy Region. Sustained migration has increased domestic water demand, intensified fishing activities, and contributed to greater pressure on aquatic ecosystems, leading to declining water availability, reduced fishery resources, and deteriorating aquatic biodiversity. However, these environmental changes result from the combined effects of migration, climate variability, population growth, and inadequate natural resource governance rather than migration alone. This study provides an integrated understanding of the relationships between migration and aquatic resource management in southwestern Madagascar and highlights the need for coordinated policies promoting sustainable water management, responsible fisheries, biodiversity conservation, climate adaptation, and migration-sensitive development planning.
papers.summary_cn: 研究马达加斯加南部Antandroy人口迁移对水资源、渔业及水生生物多样性的影响。采用混合方法，对150名受访者进行问卷、访谈和实地观察。结果表明，迁移主要由干旱和粮食不安全驱动，导致用水需求增加、捕捞强度加大，进而造成水资源减少、渔业资源衰退和生物多样性下降。这些变化是迁移、气候变异、人口增长和治理不足共同作用的结果，需制定协调政策促进可持续水资源管理、负责任渔业和气候适应。

papers.title: Assessment of Small‐Meshed Gillnets for Sustainable Fisheries in the Chobe River, Namibia
papers.authors: Simasiku, Evans Kamwi; Hove, Kudakwashe; Lukubwe, Michael Sinvula; Madzingira, Oscar; Bokhutlo, Thethela
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Small‐meshed gillnets are restricted by the regulatory framework of the Namibian Inland Fisheries Act of 2003. This is mainly because smaller meshed nets are presumably selective towards juveniles of the large‐growing cichlid species. Thus, the aim of this study was to assess the impacts of smaller meshed gillnets (<73 mm) on the fish stocks of the Zambezi/Chobe River. Experimental gillnet surveys, using variable mesh sizes of 25, 38, 51 and 64 mm, were conducted from October 2024 to September 2025. The most dominant species by Index of Relative Importance (IRI) were non‐cichlids such as the squeaker ( Synodontis spp.—28.6%IRI), tigerfish ( Hydrocynus vittatus —25.6%IRI), silver catfish ( Schilbe intermedius —27.2%IRI) and the Zambezi bulldog ( Marcusenius altisambesi —6.5%IRI). Individual catch rates of these species varied significantly among the mesh sizes ( p < 0.05). Mesh sizes 38 and 51 mm were relatively more efficient among other mesh sizes. However, smaller meshed gillnets of 25, 38, 51 and 64 mm showed a higher selection for juvenile H. vittatus , raising a concern of growth overfishing. Capturing immature H. vittatus could compromise their breeding and recruitment success. In light of these findings, the study cautions against the adoption of smaller mesh‐sized gillnets as an anticipated strategy to target for smaller growing species in the Chobe River. Maintaining restrictions on these gears is critical to ensure sustainable recruitment and a viable population of commercially and ecologically important species, such as H. vittatus .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估纳米比亚Chobe River小网目刺网（<73 mm）对鱼类资源的影响。2024年10月至2025年9月实验显示，非丽鱼科鱼类（如Synodontis spp.、Hydrocynus vittatus等）占优势，38和51 mm网目效率较高。但小网目（25-64 mm）对幼体H. vittatus选择性高，存在生长型过度捕捞风险，可能损害其繁殖与补充。建议维持现有法规限制，以保障关键物种的可持续补充。

papers.title: Energy Channel Coupling by Mid‐Trophic Level Fish Challenges the Landscape Theory for Food Web Architecture in a Large Tropical Lake Ecosystem
papers.authors: Muehl, Madison F.; Olin, Jill A.; Keyombe, James L.; Aller, Josephine Y.; Cerrato, Robert M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Landscape theory for food web architecture (LTFWA) posits that the stability of food webs is supported by the coupling of fast pelagic and slow littoral energy channels mediated by large mobile consumers. Empirical tests of the LTFWA are limited, and support for the LTFWA varies among and within aquatic ecosystems. While the LTFWA is thought to be supported in large lake ecosystems, empirical studies have focused on temperate environments with little emphasis on large tropical lake ecosystems. Lake Turkana, a climatically sensitive East African Great Lake, is a highly resilient desert lake and an ideal model for examining how consumer fish species may mediate the coupling of fast and slow energy channels within food webs in a large tropical lake ecosystem. To empirically test the LTFWA, we explored the ecological niche characteristics of five important Lake Turkana fish species including Alestes baremoze , Brachyalestes ferox , Hydrocynus forskahlii , Lates niloticus , and Oreochromis niloticus across ontogeny and used a Bayesian isotope mixing model approach to identify which species play important roles in coupling the fast pelagic and slow littoral energy channels. We reveal that mid‐trophic level fish species like A. baremoze , B. ferox , and O. niloticus play important roles in coupling energy channels in Lake Turkana, subverting expectations that upper trophic level consumers H. forskahlii and L. niloticus would couple energy channels the most. We demonstrate that the energy coupling patterns proposed by the LTFWA are not ubiquitously supported across all large lake ecosystems, and small‐bodied mid‐trophic level fish species are vital for coupling energy channels in Lake Turkana. Thus, fisheries management in Lake Turkana should aim to sustain populations of mid‐trophic level species that couple pelagic and littoral energy channels via a multispecies approach that considers interspecific trophic interactions between targeted fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在检验景观食物网结构理论（LTFWA）在大型热带湖泊生态系统中的适用性。通过分析图尔卡纳湖五种鱼类（Alestes baremoze、Brachyalestes ferox、Hydrocynus forskahlii、Lates niloticus和Oreochromis niloticus）的生态位特征，并采用贝叶斯同位素混合模型，发现中营养级鱼类（如A. baremoze、B. ferox和O. niloticus）在耦合快速浮游和慢速沿岸能量通道中起关键作用，而非预期的顶级捕食者。结果表明，LTFWA的能量耦合模式并非普遍适用于所有大型湖泊，中营养级小型鱼类对维持图尔卡纳湖能量通道耦合至关重要。因此，渔业管理应采取多物种方法，优先保护这些耦合能量通道的中营养级鱼类种群。

papers.title: Linking Multivariate Assemblage Structure With GAM‐Based Habitat Responses of Pelagic Fishes in the East China Sea and Sea of Japan
papers.authors: Ohshimo, Seiji; Kunimatsu, Shota; Enomoto, Megumi; Muko, Soyoka; Igeta, Yosuke; Kurota, Hiroyuki
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding how pelagic fish assemblages reorganize in response to oceanographic variability is central to fisheries oceanography. We analyzed long‐term purse‐seine logbook data (1994–2022) from the East China Sea and Sea of Japan to link multivariate assemblage structure with species‐specific occurrence and habitat responses. Seasonal nonmetric multidimensional scaling (nMDS) ordinations followed by k ‐means clustering revealed pronounced temporal reorganization of assemblages, including contractions of sardine‐dominated groups and a marked northward expansion of Japanese amberjack. To explore the environmental factors underlying these shifts, we fitted generalized additive models (GAMs) for nine pelagic taxa. To evaluate robustness to fishing effort, additional CPUE‐based GAMs were also examined as a robustness check. Variable‐importance analyses showed that broad‐scale spatial variation (captured by the spatial smoother, representing geographic and oceanographic structure) was the dominant predictor of species occurrence, followed by subsurface temperature at 50 m. Thermal responses varied among taxa, including dome‐shaped responses indicating optimal temperature ranges, monotonic increases in warm‐affinity species, and negative responses in cold‐affinity species such as chub mackerel. The shelf indicator further distinguished species with contrasting affinities for coastal versus off‐shelf habitats. Predicted spatial distributions from the GAMs were broadly consistent with multivariate assemblage patterns, providing a complementary perspective on species distributions within the same dataset. These findings highlight the value of integrating assemblage‐level analyses with species‐specific occurrence‐based habitat analyses to understand climate‐driven changes in pelagic fish communities and to support ecosystem‐based, climate‐responsive fisheries management.
papers.summary_cn: 基于1994-2022年东海和日本海的围网渔获数据，采用非度量多维尺度分析（nMDS）和k-means聚类揭示了中上层鱼类群落的季节性重组，包括沙丁鱼主导类群收缩和鰤鱼向北扩张。广义加性模型（GAM）分析表明，空间变化和50米层水温是影响9种中上层鱼类分布的主导因子，不同物种对温度呈现钟形、单调递增或负响应等差异化反应。研究整合了群落结构与物种栖息地响应分析，为气候驱动的中上层鱼类群落变化和生态系统管理提供了依据。

papers.title: Integrated digestive and metabolic traits underlie trophic differentiation in juvenile fish assemblages
papers.authors: Albanesi, Camila; Méndez, Eugenia; Toraño, Juan Cruz; Michiels, María Soledad
papers.abstract: Abstract Physiological traits related to digestion and energy allocation play a central role in shaping trophic strategies and niche differentiation among coexisting fish species. Here, we evaluated digestive enzyme activities, intestinal coefficient (IC) and energy reserves in three juvenile fish species inhabiting a coastal lagoon system ( Mugil liza , Odontesthes argentinensis and Oligosarcus jenynsii ) with contrasting feeding habits and trophic strategies. Clear interspecific differences were observed: M. liza exhibited higher amylase activity and intestinal coefficient values, whereas O. argentinensis and O. jenynsii showed greater proteolytic activity. Energy reserve patterns also differed markedly, with O. argentinensis characterized by elevated hepatic triglycerides and O. jenynsii associated with glycogen and protein‐related variables. Principal component analysis revealed clear multivariate differentiation among species, indicating coordinated variation across digestive and metabolic traits. These findings highlight that digestive physiology, intestinal morphology and energy allocation form an integrated functional axis underlying trophic differentiation and suggest that such physiological integration may facilitate species coexistence in coastal lagoon ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过测定三种共存幼鱼（Mugil liza、Odontesthes argentinensis、Oligosarcus jenynsii）的消化酶活性、肠道系数及能量储备，揭示了消化与代谢性状的整合机制在营养分化中的作用。结果显示，M. liza具有较高的淀粉酶活性和肠道系数，而另两种鱼类的蛋白水解活性更强；能量储备模式亦存在显著种间差异。主成分分析表明，消化生理、肠道形态与能量分配构成协同变化的整合功能轴，可能促进沿海泻湖生态系统中鱼类的共存。

papers.title: Beyond the scales: Marine archaeogenomics for the conservation and restoration of fisheries
papers.authors: Atmore, Lane M.; Star, Bastiaan
papers.abstract: Protection and restoration of marine environments are essential for food security and climate change mitigation. Yet historical and archaeological research have shown that conservation and management often rely on arbitrary ecological baselines in ecosystems already shaped by long-term human impacts. Archaeogenomics, the combination of ancient DNA (aDNA) and whole-genome sequencing, provides invaluable insights into these impacts. Recent improvements in laboratory and computational techniques enable the assessment of past fish population dynamics, migration patterns, historical trade routes, long-term anthropogenic pressures, and responses to environmental change. This Review compiles aDNA research on archaeological fish remains, emphasizing studies from 2020 to 2025 that used whole-genome analysis to investigate historical fisheries and marine ecosystem change. We highlight the growing potential of archaeogenomics to inform restoration, conservation, sustainable fisheries management, and climate adaptation strategies worldwide.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了海洋考古基因组学（archaeogenomics）在渔业保护与恢复中的应用，通过结合古DNA（aDNA）和全基因组测序技术，评估历史鱼类种群动态、迁移模式及长期人为影响。研究汇总了2020至2025年间基于全基因组分析的鱼类遗存研究，强调该方法可为恢复、保护、可持续渔业管理及气候适应策略提供关键基线信息，弥补传统生态基线依赖的不足。

papers.title: Fish Germline Stem Cells: Biological Traits, Culture Techniques, Germplasm Repositories and Application Prospects
papers.authors: Ren, Yuqin; Han, Zengsheng; Yang, Yucong; Gao, He; Ren, Jiangong; San, Lize; Zhang, Heng; Kang, Xianjiang; Hou, Jilun
papers.abstract: Fish germline stem cells (GSCs) are pivotal mediators in the transmission of genetic information across generations, possessing irreplaceable significance in aquatic germplasm protection and genetic breeding. Stable in vitro culture serves as an essential prerequisite for construction of standardized fish GSC germplasm repositories. Only by developing a robust culture system to sustain long-term proliferation and stemness of GSCs can large-scale cell reserves be established and long-term safe preservation be realized, and relevant applications including germ cell transplantation (GCT), in vitro differentiation and gene editing be further supported. However, most existing studies focus merely on individual techniques or partial research modules, while few integrate GSC biological mechanisms, in vitro culture systems, and germplasm repository construction with downstream industrial applications. This review elaborates the biological characteristics and classification of fish GSCs, summarizes the regulatory mechanisms of GSC fate determination, and comprehensively updates the research progress of in vitro culture technology and germplasm repository development. Multiple application scenarios based on cell bank resources are holistically illustrated, and prevailing technical and industrial challenges are analyzed. The study aims to provide theoretical reference for promoting technological innovation and practical utilization of fish germ stem cell research.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统阐述了鱼类生殖干细胞（GSCs）的生物学特性、分类及命运决定调控机制，全面更新了体外培养技术和种质库建设的研究进展。研究整合了GSC生物学机制、培养体系与种质资源保存，并探讨了基于细胞库的生殖细胞移植（GCT）、体外分化和基因编辑等下游应用场景。文章还分析了当前技术与产业化面临的挑战，旨在为鱼类生殖干细胞研究的技术创新和实际应用提供理论参考。

papers.title: A Deep Learning Architecture for Smart Fish Farm Management and Early Mortality Prediction
papers.authors: Isaac, Samson; Lass, Barna Thomas; Akpakoro, Ebi-Okan; Bala, Rukayyat; Abalaka, Basil Omojo
papers.journal: Journal of Science Research and Reviews
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of aquaculture has intensified the need for intelligent, data-driven systems capable of improving fish farm productivity, sustainability, and operational efficiency. Traditional manual management approaches remain limited by labor intensity, inconsistent monitoring, and delayed decision-making, especially in dynamic aquatic environments. This study presents a Deep Learning–based Fish Farming Management System that integrates Internet of Things (IoT) sensing technologies with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network to provide real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and intelligent decision support. IoT-enabled sensors continuously capture water quality and behavioral parameters, which are transmitted to a centralized data-processing architecture for storage, analysis, and automated alerts. The BiLSTM model primarily focuses on fish mortality classification, where it analyzes temporal patterns in environmental and behavioral data to predict mortality risk with high reliability. In addition, the system supports auxiliary predictive and recommendation functions, including anomaly detection and rule-assisted recommendations for feeding, aeration, and environmental adjustments, which are derived from learned temporal trends and domain constraints rather than independently optimized predictive models. Experimental results for the mortality classification task demonstrate outstanding performance, with the model achieving 96.55% accuracy, 96.97% precision, 96.67% recall, a Cohen’s Kappa score of 0.9482, and an average AUC of 0.9947, significantly outperforming benchmark models.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于深度学习的智能水产养殖管理系统，整合IoT传感技术与双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）网络，实现实时水质和行为监测、异常检测及决策支持。模型聚焦鱼类死亡风险分类，通过分析环境与行为时间序列数据，在实验中达到96.55%准确率、96.97%精确率、96.67%召回率及0.9947的AUC，显著优于基准模型。系统还提供基于时序趋势和领域规则的辅助功能（如投喂、增氧建议），旨在提升养殖效率与可持续性。

papers.title: Health Challenges in Semi-Open Mountain Reservoir Aquaculture: A Case Study in Oncorhynchus mykis
papers.authors: Rîmbu, Cristina Mihaela; Horhogea, Cristina Elena; Carp-Cărare, Cătălin; Grecu, Mariana; Anița, Adriana Elena; Anița, Dragoș Constantin; Barbacariu, Cristian-Alin; Burducea, Marian; Motrescu, Iuliana; Popovici, Ivona
papers.abstract: Bacterial diseases remain a significant threat to salmonid aquaculture worldwide, especially in semi-open cage culture systems that are exposed daily to natural aquatic environments. This study investigates recurring bacterial disease events in Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) raised in a semi-open cage culture facility in the Bicaz mountain reservoir in Romania. Longitudinal monitoring was conducted through clinical assessment of fish health, post-mortem examination of fish that died during recurrent mortality events, bacterial isolation followed by MALDI-TOF MS identification, and determination of antimicrobial susceptibility profiles of the isolated bacteria from 2023 to 2026. These investigations demonstrated the presence of classical pathogenic bacteria found in salmonids as well as a diverse range of opportunistic environmental bacteria. Recurrently identified bacteria included Aeromonas hydrophila, Yersinia ruckeri, Aeromonas salmonicida, Aeromonas veronii, Pseudomonas fluorescens, Hafnia alvei, Enterobacter aerogenes, Providencia alcalifaciens, and Flavobacterium psychrophilum. Mixed bacterial infection resulted in several of the bacterial disease outbreaks, indicating that there are likely to be complex microbial relationships within this semi-open aquaculture environment. Susceptibility profiles of antibiotics tested against the isolated bacteria indicated that some antibiotic classes had varying degrees of susceptibility between different bacterial disease outbreaks and also varied between susceptible and resistant strains of the same bacterial species. Susceptibility profiles were most commonly noted for florfenicol and fluoroquinolone, while beta-lactams, macrolides, and lincosamides displayed variable levels of resistance or diminished susceptibility patterns, particularly among Aeromonas spp. strains. Therefore, the results highlight the dynamic epidemiological characteristics of bacterial infections occurring in semi-open mountain aquaculture systems and underscores the importance of longitudinal bacteriological surveillance under commercial farming conditions.
