Permanent interaction between cultured fish and the aquatic microbiota may influence the recurrence and microbial complexity of bacterial outbreaks in reservoir-based salmonid aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了罗马尼亚Bicaz山区水库半开放网箱养殖虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中反复爆发的细菌性疾病，通过2023–2026年纵向监测，结合临床评估、尸检、MALDI-TOF MS细菌鉴定及抗菌药物敏感性测试，揭示了病原菌多样性及混合感染特征。主要检出菌包括Aeromonas hydrophila、Yersinia ruckeri、Aeromonas salmonicida等经典及机会性病原体，且不同爆发间抗生素敏感性差异显著，氟苯尼考和氟喹诺酮类最有效，而β-内酰胺类、大环内酯类和林可酰胺类耐药性较高。结果表明半开放养殖系统中细菌感染的动态流行病学复杂性，强调商业条件下长期细菌学监测的必要性，并指出养殖鱼与水生微生物群的持续互作可能加剧爆发复发。

papers.title: Salmon Aquaculture and Sovereignties at Sea: Eviction as a Tool for Reclaiming Indigenous Seascapes in Coastal British Columbia
papers.authors: Evans, Darcey
papers.journal: American Indian Culture and Research Journal
papers.abstract: This article argues that Indigenous practices of eviction can serve as a method of territorial reclamation that challenges state claims to property and jurisdiction within unceded Indigenous homelands. In the coastal seascapes of British Columbia, Indigenous leaders travel to docks, corporate offices, fish processing factories, and sites of aquaculture production with notices of eviction, seeking to evict industrial aquaculture facilities from the coast and asserting that coastal waterscapes are unceded Indigenous territories. This article suggests that attempts to evict aquaculture facilities go beyond specific companies, infrastructures, and industrial practices to also refuse the legal status of coastal waterways and seabeds as a “public commons” under state ownership. In positioning the state as a landlord of the sea and seabed, I further explore how evictions intervene in the landlord-tenant relationships between state and industry that are characteristic of how resource development and extraction occur within public lands and waters in settler states. While practices of eviction offer emerging avenues for realizing Land Back and Water Back objectives, the article ends by considering how the enduring legal classification of coastal waterways as “public” causes Indigenous claims to seascapes to come into friction with historical and international components of marine governance. In this context, the politics and processes of evicting industrial aquaculture facilities from the waterways of BC offers insights into how colonial histories inform contemporary coastal and ocean governance and how the exercise of Indigenous rights and sovereignties are influencing how ocean-based development unfolds.
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨了加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省沿海原住民通过驱逐工业水产养殖设施，作为收回未割让原住民领海主权的手段。研究分析了原住民领袖向养殖场、码头及企业发出驱逐通知的行为，挑战国家将水域视为“公共财产”的法律定位，并介入国家与产业间的“地主-租户”关系。文章指出，驱逐实践虽为实现“土地回归”和“水域回归”目标提供新路径，但水域的“公共”法律分类与原住民海景主张及国际海洋治理存在摩擦。该研究揭示了殖民历史对当代沿海和海洋治理的影响，以及原住民主权行使如何重塑海洋开发格局。

papers.title: Water, sediment, and productivity dynamics for Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture development in Mauritius
papers.authors: Nazurally, Nadeem
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦毛里求斯综合多营养层级 aquaculture（IMTA）发展的水、沉积物及生产力动态，旨在评估该区域IMTA实施的适宜性。通过分析水体理化参数、沉积物特征及初级生产力变化，揭示其时空分布规律及潜在生态制约因素。研究发现，关键环境因子（如营养盐浓度、沉积物有机质含量）对IMTA系统设计具有重要指示意义，可为当地可持续养殖模式优化提供科学依据。

papers.title: Cultivating Marine Microalgae Nannochloropsis oculata and Chaetoceros muelleri in Shrimp Farming Effluent: Growth and Nutrient Removal for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Shamsaei, Mohamad; Ghasemi, Zahra; Aminikhoei, Zahra
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Shrimp farming effluents (SFEs) are rich in nitrate and phosphate, posing significant eutrophication risks to receiving water bodies if discharged untreated, necessitating sustainable bioremediation strategies. Although microalgae‐based treatment has been explored, limited research has systematically compared the performance of different species under varying dilution ratios and initial cell densities specifically for shrimp effluent. This study assessed the cultivation performance and nutrient removal efficiency of Nannochloropsis oculata and Chaetoceros muelleri for bioremediation of SFE, focusing on nitrate and phosphate removal. Experiments evaluated nutrient dynamics and algal growth across SFE dilutions (0%–50%) and initial cell densities ( C. muelleri : 35 × 10 4 and 70 × 10 4 cells/mL; N. oculata : 200 × 10 4 and 400 × 10 4 cells/mL). Both species demonstrated effective nutrient removal, with higher removal efficiencies observed at lower initial densities. Under optimal 25% SFE conditions, N. oculata achieved 97% nitrate and 95% phosphate removal within 12 days, while C. muelleri reached 81% nitrate and 94% phosphate removal within 6 days. Specific growth rates surpassed controls, yielding maximum biomasses of 2425 × 10 4 ( N. oculata , 12 days) and 595 × 10 4 cells/mL ( C. muelleri , 10 days). The novelty of this study lies in the systematic optimization of operational parameters and identification of species‐specific advantages for tailored bioremediation. These findings highlight the robustness of both microalgae across SFE gradients and support their application in sustainable aquaculture wastewater treatment, nutrient recycling, and biomass valorization. Future studies should focus on pilot‐scale validation, long‐term stability assessment, and comprehensive biomass characterization for downstream applications.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统评估了两种海洋微藻——微拟球藻（Nannochloropsis oculata）和角毛藻（Chaetoceros muelleri）在虾养殖废水（SFE）中的生长性能及硝酸盐和磷酸盐去除效率，旨在探索可持续的生物修复策略。实验设置不同废水稀释比例（0%–50%）和初始细胞密度，发现两种藻类均能有效去除营养盐，且较低初始密度下去除效率更高；在25% SFE最优条件下，微拟球藻12天内去除97%硝酸盐和95%磷酸盐，角毛藻6天内去除81%硝酸盐和94%磷酸盐。研究通过系统优化操作参数并识别物种特异性优势，为虾养殖废水的定制化生物处理及微藻生物质资源化利用提供了理论依据，建议未来开展中试规模验证和长期稳定性评估。

papers.title: Sediment Phosphorus Storage and Release After Aquaculture Cessation: A Case Study of Datong Lake
papers.authors: Xu, Zekun; Li, Jianxiu; Tang, Zhi; Li, Caiying; Zhou, Qiaohong; Zhao, Tianhui
papers.abstract: Reducing external phosphorus (P) inputs is central to eutrophication control, but sediment P release can sustain internal loading and delay lake recovery. This study assessed sediment P composition, vertical distribution, and short-term release potential in Datong Lake, a shallow lake formerly affected by intensive aquaculture. Total phosphorus (TP), dissolved total phosphorus (DTP), and particulate phosphorus (PP) were measured in surface and overlying waters during the dry and wet seasons. Surface-sediment P fractions were characterized in both seasons, whereas dry-season sediments were used for adsorption and release tests, vertical profiling, and depth-specific incubations. Wet-season samples had higher TP, DTP, and PP concentrations in surface water and higher TP and PP concentrations in overlying water. Surface-sediment P was predominantly inorganic, with Ca-P as the largest inorganic fraction; bioavailable P accounted for about 32% of TP. In the 24-h batch tests, the adsorbed P amount exceeded the released amount. Total P and its NaOH-extractable and organic fractions were enriched in the upper sediment. Across the 1–5 to 21–25 cm intervals, 15-d cumulative P release decreased from 22.9 ± 1.9 to 7.2 ± 1.0 mg·kg−1, and the initial 3-d release rate decreased from 1.13 ± 0.18 to 0.24 ± 0.07 mg·kg−1·d−1. Overall, Datong Lake sediments contained high P concentrations but exhibited limited short-term release, with the greatest release amount and rate occurring in the upper sediment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以曾受集约化水产养殖影响的大通湖为例，评估养殖停止后沉积物磷的储存与短期释放潜力。通过干湿季采样分析表层及上覆水磷浓度、沉积物磷组分，并结合吸附释放实验与分层培养，发现湿季水体磷浓度更高，沉积物磷以无机钙结合态为主，生物可利用磷约占32%。24小时批量实验中吸附量大于释放量，15天累积磷释放量随深度从22.9降至7.2 mg·kg⁻¹，初始3天释放速率亦显著降低，表明沉积物磷含量高但短期释放有限，上层沉积物释放潜力最大。

papers.title: Nitrogen Budget Illustrates the Efficiency of Co-Farming Sea Lettuce (Ulva fenestrata) with Cold-Water Fish in a Marine Recirculating Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Andersson, Marica; Dahllöf, Ingela; Stedt, Kristoffer; Steinhagen, Sophie; Roques, Jonathan A. C.; Pavia, Henrik; Sundell, Kristina Snuttan
papers.abstract: Integrated multitrophic level aquaculture (IMTA) in land-based recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) has been proposed as an effective nitrogen bioremediation strategy. It can improve the utilization of added nitrogen through further biomass production, which increases the sustainability and efficiency of the farming system. Few studies have evaluated how co-farming in cold-water land-based marine recirculating aquaculture systems affects the nitrogen utilization; here, we quantify the effects of co-farming sea lettuce (Ulva fenestrata) with Atlantic wolffish (Anarhichas lupus) and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in such a system. Nitrogen budgets were used to evaluate the efficiency of the system by summarizing all processes, both inputs and outputs. In alternating four-week periods for four months, the recirculating system held either only fish or fish together with sea lettuce. Fish biomass held 90–91% of the system nitrogen, while 9–10% was available as dissolved inorganic nitrogen. The nitrogen uptake by the sea lettuce biomass was quantified to 1.0–1.5% of the total nitrogen input. Extrapolations based on these results show that a wet weight ratio of sea lettuce:fish of 0.7 would be optimal for remediation of all added nitrogen.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过氮收支分析，评估了冷海水陆基循环 aquaculture 系统中海莴苣（Ulva fenestrata）与大西洋狼鱼（Anarhichas lupus）及虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）共养的氮利用效率。结果显示，鱼类生物量固定了系统总氮的90–91%，溶解无机氮占9–10%，而海莴苣仅吸收总氮输入的1.0–1.5%。基于外推，海莴苣与鱼类的湿重比达0.7时，可最优化去除所有添加氮，表明共养策略在提高氮利用和系统可持续性方面具有潜力。

papers.title: Subchronic PAH Exposure Impacts Cardiac Electrophysiology of the Polar Fish, Navaga Cod (Eleginus nawaga)
papers.authors: Dzhumaniiazova, Irina; Filatova, Tatiana S.; Shamshura, Artem V.; Abramochkin, Denis V.
papers.abstract: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) from the water-soluble fraction (WSF) of crude oil are recognized cardiotoxicants in fish; however, all electrophysiological evidence to date derives from acute exposure experiments. This study examined the effects of prolonged (5–8 h) incubation of isolated ventricular cardiomyocytes from the navaga cod (Eleginus nawaga, Walbaum, 1792) with 10% WSF (total dissolved tricyclic-PAH concentration in the tens-of-nM), 3 µM phenanthrene (Phe), or 3 µM 3-methylphenanthrene (3-MP) on action potential (AP) parameters and the underlying ionic currents using the whole-cell patch-clamp technique. WSF and 3-MP reduced AP amplitude and maximum rate of depolarization through suppression of the fast sodium current (INa), whereas Phe and 3-MP shortened AP duration, associated with decreased density and a hyperpolarizing shift in steady-state activation of the rapid delayed rectifier potassium current (IKr). The L-type calcium current and inward rectifier potassium current remained unaffected by all treatments. Notably, the effects of prolonged incubation differed qualitatively from previously reported acute responses to the same compounds, suggesting the involvement of indirect mechanisms such as reactive oxygen species production and activation of intracellular signaling cascades. These findings demonstrate that subchronic PAH exposure produces distinct and potentially proarrhythmogenic alterations in fish cardiac electrophysiology that cannot be predicted from acute exposure data alone.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了亚慢性多环芳烃（PAH）暴露对极地鱼类——纳瓦加鳕（Eleginus nawaga）心室肌细胞电生理特性的影响。通过全细胞膜片钳技术，对分离的心肌细胞进行5–8小时孵育，测试了原油水溶性组分（WSF）、菲（Phe）和3-甲基菲（3-MP）的作用。结果显示，WSF和3-MP通过抑制快速钠电流（INa）降低动作电位幅度和最大去极化速率，而Phe和3-MP缩短动作电位时程，与快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）密度下降及稳态激活超极化移位相关。与急性暴露相比，亚慢性处理产生定性不同的效应，提示涉及活性氧和细胞内信号通路的间接机制，表明亚慢性PAH暴露可导致鱼类心脏电生理的促心律失常性改变，且无法仅凭急性数据预测。

papers.title: Association between fish-related metabolites and metabolic syndrome risk factors in Japan: INTERLIPID metabolome –wide association study
papers.authors: Byambajav, Tserenlkham; Chan, Queenie; Okami, Yukiko; Kadota, Aya; Miyagawa, Naoko; Okuda, Nagako; Nakagawa, Hideaki; Sakata, Kiyomi; Saitoh, Shigeyuki; Okayama, Akira
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于日本INTERLIPID队列，采用代谢组-wide关联分析（MWAS）探讨鱼类相关代谢物与代谢综合征风险因素（如血压、血脂、血糖）的关联。研究发现特定鱼类来源代谢物（如长链多不饱和脂肪酸衍生物）与代谢综合征风险降低显著相关，提示鱼类摄入可能通过特定代谢通路发挥保护作用。研究为鱼类营养与代谢健康提供了代谢组学层面的证据支持。

papers.title: Filtration-equipped ballast water management systems as practical infrastructure for marine microplastic mitigation
papers.authors: Cha, Hyung-Gon; Jang, Pung-Guk; Jang, Min-Chul; Shin, Kyoungsoon; Lee, Woo-Jin; Seo, Jin-Young; Hyun, Bonggil
papers.abstract: Microplastics are pervasive contaminants in marine environments and are increasingly recognized as a risk to marine ecosystems and to human health. Because ships take up and discharge large volumes of seawater, ballast water has been identified as a pathway for the transport of microplastics across regions. However, quantitative evidence for microplastic capture by commercially relevant ballast water management systems (BWMSs) during system operation remains limited. In this study, we evaluated the microplastic capture potential of a Filter + UV-type BWMS equipped with a 50 μm screen filter at a land-based test facility of the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology. Influent test water and backwash water discharged during automatic filter cleaning were sampled and analyzed using micro-Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy. The influent test water contained 1,760 particles m -3 of microplastics. At the time of the sampled backwashing event, 84.0 ± 0.96 m³ of seawater had passed through the filter, corresponding to an estimated 147,769 particles entering the filtration unit. Analysis of the entire 200 L backwash sample recovered 123,337 particles, equivalent to approximately 1,469 particles m -3 of treated seawater and an apparent retention efficiency of 83.5% relative to the influent concentration. Although polymer composition differed between influent and backwash samples, the results demonstrate that commercially relevant BWMS filtration can retain and concentrate microplastics within the backwash stream. These findings highlight the potential of existing BWMS infrastructure to function as a practical interception point for marine microplastics during ballast-water treatment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了配备50 μm筛网过滤器的Filter + UV型压载水管理系统（BWMS）对海洋微塑料的截留效率，基于韩国海洋科学技术研究院陆基试验设施开展实验。通过微傅里叶变换红外光谱分析进水与反冲洗水样，发现进水含1,760颗粒/m³微塑料，单次反冲洗事件中约147,769颗粒进入过滤单元，回收123,337颗粒，表观截留效率达83.5%。结果表明，商业相关BWMS过滤可有效富集微塑料于反冲洗流中，凸显其作为压载水处理过程中微塑料实际拦截点的潜力。

papers.title: In search of resilient sponges as candidate habitat engineers for the renaturalization of polluted harbor environments
papers.authors: Maldonado, Manuel; Escarré, Carlota; Lloveras, Anna
papers.abstract: Harbor infrastructures impose strong environmental stress on coastal marine communities, limiting the persistence of many native species and hindering ecological restoration. Identifying resilient habitat-engineering organisms is therefore key to developing effective and affordable renaturalization strategies. In this study, we evaluated the suitability of five Mediterranean sponge species to withstand the process of collection, laboratory manipulation, and transplantation to a recreational harbor, where they were monitored over 455 days using image-based morphometric analyses coupled with computational modeling. Among the species tested, only Chondrosia reniformis showed high resilience under harbor conditions, with 91.7% survival. In contrast, all individuals of Corticium candelabrum , Crambe crambe , Scalarispongia scalaris , and Ircinia oros died during laboratory preparation or shortly after deployment in the harbor. Individuals of C. reniformis initially underwent a moderate size reduction but subsequently stabilized their biomass. The sponges demonstrated remarkable morphological plasticity, including continuous substrate crawling (up to 12.7 cm of total displacement) and the capacity to recover from disease. Some individuals underwent body fission during warm months, generating clonal offspring that nearly doubled the size of the experimental population in the harbor. Collectively, the results indicate that the high survival of this species in the degraded harbor environment, together with its resistance to disease, its ability to proliferate clonally, and its capacity to reposition itself for improved environmental adaption, makes C. reniformis a highly suitable candidate as putative habitat engineer in future multitrophic approaches aimed at enhancing biodiversity and renaturalizing degraded harbor environments and other anthropogenically impacted coastal habitats.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了五种地中海海绵作为栖息地工程生物用于港口污染环境修复的适宜性，通过采集、实验室操作及移植至休闲港口，并利用基于图像的形态测量分析和计算建模监测455天。结果显示，仅Chondrosia reniformis表现出高韧性，存活率达91.7%，其余四种均在实验室或移植后死亡。该物种经历初期体型缩小后趋于稳定，展现出连续基质爬行（最大位移12.7 cm）、疾病恢复及暖季裂殖增殖能力，实验种群规模近乎翻倍。研究表明，C. reniformis的高存活率、抗病性、克隆繁殖及位置调整能力，使其成为退化港口及人为影响海岸环境中多营养级生态修复的理想候选栖息地工程物种。

papers.title: Same-same but different: habitat use and partitioning of three cryptobenthic coral reef fishes of the genus Trimma
papers.authors: Goldsworthy, Nisha C.; Srinivasan, Maya; Smallhorn-West, Patrick; Jones, Geoffrey P.
papers.abstract: Abstract Partitioning critical resources can alleviate competition among species, allow coexistence, and contribute to biodiversity. The mechanisms driving habitat partitioning within the small-bodied and highly diverse genus Trimma remain unclear. The main aim of this study was to uncover habitat use and partitioning of T. benjamini , T. capostriatum , and T. yanoi that may enable their coexistence on coral reefs in Kimbe Bay, Papua New Guinea, using a combination of active visual search transects and behavioural observations. The spatial distributions of each species were distinct. Reef aspect played a significant role, with T. yanoi and T. benjamini being most abundant on the reef wall, while T. capostriatum predominantly favoured the reef slope at offshore locations. Generally, there were variations in abundance among depths in all species, though there were exceptions for specific reef aspects. Reef location (inshore vs. offshore) influenced the distribution of T. capostriatum , but not T. benjamini or T. yanoi . Population clustering was also examined. T. yanoi formed the largest clusters of 9 individuals on average, followed by T. benjamini with 7 individuals on average. T. yanoi clusters had 1.5 times the population density per m 2 quadrat compared to T. benjamini . In contrast, T. capostriatum exhibited the smallest cluster sizes and densities, with the highest proportion (30%) of solitary individuals. At small spatial scales, coexistence was observed in 34.5–52% of m 2 quadrats. Within 1 m 2 quadrats where species coexisted, there were differences in the microhabitat that each species commonly occupied, resulting in minimal overlap of microhabitats (9.2–8.2%). Behavioural assessments revealed that interactions between Trimma species were rare, involving less than 1% of individuals. These findings exemplify how small reef fish can effectively partition habitats even when closely related, with almost identical body size and morphology.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过主动视觉搜索样带与行为观察，探究巴布亚新几内亚金贝湾三种礁栖小型鱼类（Trimma benjamini、T. capostriatum、T. yanoi）的栖息地利用与分化机制。结果显示，三种鱼的空间分布差异显著：T. yanoi和T. benjamini主要分布于礁壁，而T. capostriatum偏好离岸礁坡；深度和礁区位置（近岸vs.离岸）对分布有不同程度影响。种群聚集方面，T. yanoi平均集群最大（9尾），T. benjamini次之（7尾），T. capostriatum集群最小且30%为独居个体。在1 m²尺度上，三种鱼共存率达34.5–52%，但微栖息地重叠极低（9.2–8.2%），且种间行为互作罕见（<1%个体）。研究表明，即使体型和形态高度相似，近缘小型礁鱼仍能通过精细的栖息地分化实现共存。

papers.title: Increased temperature decreases starvation resiliency in first feeding sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria)
papers.authors: Fennie, Will; Porter, Steven M; Axler, Kelia; Snyder, Brooke; Deary, Alison L
papers.abstract: Waters in the Gulf of Alaska experienced anomalously high temperatures during a recent outbreak of large marine heatwaves (2014-2016 and 2019). These warming events caused shifts in the reproductive phenology of zooplankton and fish species, potentially creating trophic mismatches between the availability of zooplankton prey and the initiation of larval fish feeding. To better understand the implications of warming-induced trophic mismatches on sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria) starvation resiliency, we reared larval sablefish in the laboratory under two temperature treatments (6°C & 9°C) with two nested feeding treatments (fed & starved). We measured the point of no return, daily larval length, weight, and yolk sac size trajectories, and body morphometrics. Sablefish larvae experienced an 11-day decrease in time to reach point of no return at 9°C, diverging length and weight trajectories between starved and fed larvae at 9°C, smaller yolk sac size at first feeding and earlier depletion at 9°C, and changes in skull morphology between temperature and feeding treatments. These results indicate that sablefish starvation resiliency greatly decreases under anomalous warming in the Gulf of Alaska.
papers.summary_cn: 阿拉斯加湾近年海洋热浪（2014-2016、2019）导致浮游动物与鱼类繁殖物候错配，可能影响仔鱼早期摄食。本研究在实验室条件下，以6°C和9°C两种温度及投喂/饥饿处理饲养首喂期裸盖鱼（Anoplopoma fimbria）仔鱼，测定不可逆点、体长体重、卵黄囊动态及形态特征。结果显示，9°C下仔鱼达到不可逆点的时间缩短11天，饥饿与投喂个体的生长轨迹分化更早，卵黄囊初始更小且消耗更快，头骨形态亦随温度与摄食处理改变。研究表明，阿拉斯加湾异常升温显著降低裸盖鱼仔鱼的饥饿耐受能力。

papers.title: Biofluorescence in polar zoarcid eelpouts: The Arctic eelpout Lycodes reticulatus (Reinhardt, 1835) and the Antarctic eelpout Pachycara brachycephalum (Pappenheim, 1912)
papers.authors: Juhasz‐Dora, Thomas; Slater, Matthew; Karamyar, Amirhossein; Lindberg, Stein‐Kato
papers.abstract: Abstract Biofluorescence is widespread among marine fish but remains poorly documented in polar ecosystems. Using hyperspectral imaging, we report fluorescent emissions in two polar zoarcid eelpouts. A captive Antarctic eelpout ( Pachycara brachycephalum ) displayed uniform bright green fluorescence (~500–520 nm), whereas an Arctic eelpout ( Lycodes reticulatus ) showed weaker patterned emissions (~510–590 nm). Under identical illumination, the Arctic cod ( Boreogadus saida ) exhibited no detectable fluorescence. Although observations were limited to single individuals per species, spectral peaks substantially exceeded calibration reference values, indicating genuine fluorescent emissions. These observations represent the first reported occurrence of biofluorescence in an Antarctic teleost and expand the phylogenetic distribution of fluorescent fish to include Zoarcidae. The results also demonstrate the potential of portable hyperspectral imaging for non‐invasive detection of fluorescent traits in cold‐adapted fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用高光谱成像技术，首次报道了两种极地绵鳚科鱼类的生物荧光现象：南极绵鳚（*Pachycara brachycephalum*）呈现均匀亮绿色荧光（~500–520 nm），而北极绵鳚（*Lycodes reticulatus*）则表现出较弱的斑块状发射（~510–590 nm）。在相同光照条件下，北极鳕（*Boreogadus saida*）未检测到荧光，且光谱峰值显著超过校准参考值，确认了真实荧光发射。尽管观察仅基于单一个体，但这是南极硬骨鱼类生物荧光的首次记录，将荧光鱼类的系统发育分布扩展至Zoarcidae科，并展示了便携式高光谱成像在冷适应鱼类非侵入性荧光性状检测中的潜力。

papers.title: Mesoscale Oceanographic Processes Drive the Seasonal Abundance of the Seabob Shrimp Xiphopenaeus spp. on the Eastern Brazilian Shelf
papers.authors: Rabelo, Leandro Bonesi; de Araújo, Júlio Neves; Martins, Agnaldo Silva
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The seabob shrimp ( Xiphopenaeus spp.) is a primary fishery resource in Brazil, with considerable economic and social importance along the coast. While environmental drivers of its life cycle are well‐documented for southeastern and southern populations, the factors modulating populations in the Eastern Brazilian Shelf remain poorly understood, affecting resource management directly. To assess the influence of mesoscale oceanographic processes on the abundance of the seabob shrimp within the Abrolhos Bank, a 19‐year time series of relative abundance, primary productivity, bottom water temperature, and river flow was analyzed using generalized additive models. Abundance peaks were identified in austral autumn and spring, revealing non‐linear, time‐dependent relationships between CPUE and environmental predictors. The seasonal interaction model indicated that the May abundance peak resulted from the combined effect of cooling and increased primary productivity. Abundance increased by up to 35% during these peaks, while river discharge exhibited a predominantly inverse relationship. Our findings indicate that eastern populations are modulated by Vitória Eddy and South Atlantic Central Water upwelling over the Abrolhos Bank. This regional differentiation reflects the ecological plasticity of Xiphopenaeus spp. and its adaptation to regional processes that enhance nutrient supply. These results support site‐specific management and conservation strategies across the Southwestern Atlantic.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了巴西东部陆架Abrolhos Bank地区19年间的相对丰度、初级生产力、底层水温和河流流量数据，运用广义加性模型评估中尺度海洋过程对seabob shrimp（Xiphopenaeus spp.）丰度的影响。研究发现丰度峰值出现在南半球秋季和春季，5月峰值由降温与初级生产力增加共同驱动，丰度最高可提升35%，而河流径流总体呈负相关关系。结果表明，东部种群受Vitória涡旋和南大西洋中央水上涌的调控，体现了该物种对不同区域营养供给过程的生态适应性，为西南大西洋的位点特异性管理和保护策略提供了科学依据。

papers.title: High‐Throughput Sequencing in Aquaculture Disease Investigations: Challenges and Opportunities for Implementation
papers.authors: Samsing, Francisca; Arbon, Phoebe; Arnold, Matthew; Barnes, Andrew C.; Bass, David; Becker, Joy A.; Bennett, Jerusha; Caraguel, Charles; Carson, Jeremy; Costa, Vincenzo A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The current generation of sequencing technologies can produce terabases of data with exceptional accuracy and speed, at a fraction of the cost of older methods. Despite this unprecedented power, adoption into aquaculture health management presents several challenges, including identifying where such capability may be optimally deployed. Here we synthesise discussions from a structured expert workshop held at the 2025 Aotearoa Aquatic Diseases Symposium in Dunedin, New Zealand, where experts from industry, government and academia explored the challenges and opportunities for adopting high‐throughput sequencing (HTS) to support disease investigations in aquaculture. Workshop participants identified key applications for HTS, including pathogen discovery during unexplained mortality events and source attribution in epidemics, but also noted technical, regulatory and social challenges for widespread adoption. These include the need for standardised sampling and bioinformatic workflows, data sovereignty, equitable access to the technology and uncertainty around interpreting detection of notifiable pathogens. Targeted research and coordinated regulatory frameworks will be essential to guide responsible use of HTS and determine where it adds value relative to existing approaches. Clarifying these opportunities and constraints will guide the responsible adoption of HTS into aquaculture health management to support sustainable growth for the sector.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过2025年新西兰达尼丁水产疾病研讨会专家讨论，分析了高通量测序（HTS）在水产养殖疾病调查中的应用机遇与挑战。主要应用包括不明原因死亡事件的病原发现和流行病溯源，但面临标准化采样流程、生物信息学工作流、数据主权、技术可及性及可报告病原解读等障碍。需通过针对性研究和协调监管框架，明确HTS相对于传统方法的增值场景，以推动其在水产健康管理中的负责任应用。

papers.title: Governability of vulnerability to viability transitions in transboundary small-scale fisheries: a study on the Sundarbans
papers.authors: Miah, Md. Ruyel; Nayak, Prateep Kumar; Pittman, Jeremy; Chuenpagdee, Ratana
papers.summary_cn: 研究孟加拉国孙德尔本斯跨界小规模渔业中，从脆弱性向可行性转变的治理能力。通过分析该区域渔业系统的治理复杂性，探讨如何通过适应性管理提升渔民生计韧性。发现跨界资源治理、生态脆弱性与社会制度互动是影响转型的关键因素。

papers.title: Short-term temporal fluctuation in fish environmental DNA production in relation to feeding condition and marker type
papers.authors: Jo, Toshiaki S.; Ogawa, Shiori; Hayami, Kana; Watanabe, Takeshi; Maki, Nobutaka; Wu, Qianqian; Minamoto, Toshifumi
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了鱼类环境DNA（eDNA）产量在短期内的波动，重点关注摄食条件和标记类型的影响。通过实验分析，发现摄食活动显著影响eDNA释放速率，且不同遗传标记（如线粒体与核DNA）的检测效率存在差异。研究结果为优化eDNA采样策略、提高渔业资源监测准确性提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Role of Fish Communities in Incorporating Methane-Derived Carbon in a Tropical Floodplain Lake System
papers.authors: Urbano, Vinícius Andrade; de Carvalho, Débora Reis; Alves, Carlos Bernardo Mascarenhas; Pompeu, Paulo Santos
papers.abstract: Abstract Floodplain systems play a key role in methane emissions. However, part of this methane can be oxidized by methanotrophic bacteria and incorporated into their biomass, thereby reducing methane release to the atmosphere. Consumers of methanotrophic bacteria, such as zooplankton and benthic invertebrates, serve as links for transferring methane-derived carbon to higher trophic levels in the food web. Here, we used carbon and nitrogen stable isotopes to investigate the role of fish communities in the incorporation of methane-derived carbon, considering the influence of feeding guilds, seasonality (wet and dry), and fish size. We hypothesized that fish relying on aquatic macroinvertebrates would exhibit a higher proportion of methane-derived carbon, particularly during the wet season. We found that between 4.80 and 17.56% (95% credible interval) of fish biomass was composed of methane-derived carbon. No differences were observed among trophic guilds, likely due to variability in habitat use and foraging strategies among species within the same guild. Species that feed on zooplankton mainly during their juvenile stages showed a decrease in methane assimilation with growth. In contrast, species that are zooplanktivorous as adults exhibited an increase. Contrary to expectations, the contribution of methane-derived carbon to fish biomass was greater during the dry season. This may reflect both turnover rate and reduced habitat availability during low water levels, which forces consumers to rely mainly on autochthonous resources such as invertebrates. These results highlight methane-derived carbon as an important energy source for floodplain consumers, demonstrating that microbial methane oxidation plays a significant role in sustaining higher trophic levels in tropical floodplain ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 利用碳氮稳定同位素研究热带洪泛平原湖泊鱼类群落对甲烷衍生碳的整合作用。结果显示鱼类生物量中4.80-17.56%来自甲烷衍生碳，食性类群间无显著差异，但鱼类个体发育阶段和季节变化影响甲烷碳同化率。旱季甲烷碳贡献率高于雨季，可能与低水位时栖息地减少迫使消费者依赖本地资源有关。研究表明微生物甲烷氧化作用对维持热带洪泛平原生态系统高营养级具有重要贡献。

papers.title: Tissue-Specific Variation in DNA and RNA Content of Disco Rani Fish Using Classical Colorimetric Methods
papers.authors: Aade, Ulka; Yadav, Amarnath; Kedar, G. T.; Shaikh, Mohammed Shahid; Shaikh, Rahil; Malik, Shaheer
papers.abstract: Quantitative estimation of nucleic acids can provide comparative information on tissue composition and physiological activity. This study estimated DNA and RNA contents in the liver and gill tissues of Disco Rani fish (Priacanthus hamrur) using classical colorimetric procedures. DNA was measured using the diphenylamine method, whereas RNA was measured using the orcinol method. Absorbance was recorded with a colorimeter, and tissue concentrations were calculated from standard solutions. The estimated DNA concentration was higher in the liver (5.90 mg/ml) than in the gills (4.28 mg/ml). Conversely, RNA concentration was higher in the gills (7.40 mg/ml) than in the liver (5.80 mg/ml). The calculated RNA/DNA ratio was 0.98 in the liver and 1.73 in the gills, indicating greater RNA abundance relative to DNA in gill tissue under the experimental conditions. The DNA standard curve showed a progressive increase in absorbance with concentration, while the RNA standard curve displayed an overall increasing trend with minor deviations. These findings demonstrate descriptive tissue-specific differences in nucleic acid content. The higher DNA value in the liver may reflect differences in tissue architecture and cellular composition, whereas the higher RNA concentration and RNA/DNA ratio in the gills may be associated with their continuous physiological functions. The results remain preliminary because biological replication, inferential statistical analysis and molecular validation were not included.
papers.summary_cn: 采用经典比色法（二苯胺法测DNA，地衣酚法测RNA）测定了Disco Rani鱼（Priacanthus hamrur）肝脏和鳃组织的核酸含量。结果显示肝脏DNA浓度（5.90 mg/ml）高于鳃（4.28 mg/ml），而鳃RNA浓度（7.40 mg/ml）及RNA/DNA比值（1.73）均高于肝脏（0.98），表明鳃组织RNA相对丰度更高，可能与其持续生理功能相关。该研究揭示了组织特异性核酸差异，但缺乏生物学重复和统计验证，结果属初步性。

papers.title: Assessment of Microplastic Pollution, Seasonal Dynamic and Polymer Composition in Water, Sediment, and Fish from Mairuwa Reservoir, Funtua, Katsina Northwestern Nigeria<b></b>
papers.authors: Sulaiman, Muhammad; Usman, Usman Lawal; Mudassir, Badamasi; Salisu, Aliyu Abdullahi
papers.abstract: Microplastic (MP) pollution has emerged as a critical global environmental challenge, yet empirical data from Nigerian freshwater ecosystems remain scarce. This study evaluated microplastic contamination in Mairuwa Reservoir, Katsina State, Nigeria, across six months (April–September 2025). Water, sediment, and fish samples (Clarias gariepinus and Oreochromis niloticus) from nine stations were analyzed using wet peroxide oxidation, density separation, vacuum filtration, and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR). Physicochemical analysis revealed significant seasonal variation: temperature decreased from 34.00°C to 27.70°C. Turbidity peaked at 75.56 NTU, dissolved oxygen declined from 6.44 to 3.09 mg/L, pH remained alkaline (8.00–9.71). Total MP concentrations were 307 counts/L (water), 272 counts/kg (sediment), 298 counts/fish (C. gariepinus), and 253 counts/fish (O. niloticus). FTIR identified six polymers: polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polystyrene (PS), polyamide (PA/nylon), and polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Distinct distribution patterns emerged: water was dominated by PET (18.57%) and PP (18.24%); sediment by PA (22.06%) and PE (21.32%); C. gariepinus by PS (19.80%) and PVC (17.11%); and O. niloticus by PET (19.37%) and PA (20.95%). Water ingestion posed the highest risk, approximately ten times higher than fish consumption. The study concludes that Mairuwa Reservoir is significantly contaminated with microplastics originating from packaging materials, textile fibers, and fishing gear, with seasonal runoff exacerbating pollution during rainy months. Urgent interventions including water filtration, improved plastic waste management, and regulatory frameworks are recommended to safeguard public health and the reservoir ecosystem.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估尼日利亚Mairuwa水库水、沉积物及两种鱼类（Clarias gariepinus和Oreochromis niloticus）中微塑料污染的季节动态与聚合物组成。通过湿法过氧化氢氧化、密度分离及FTIR分析，发现总微塑料浓度在水体、沉积物和鱼类中分别达307 counts/L、272 counts/kg和253-298 counts/尾，其中PE、PP、PET等六种聚合物分布存在介质特异性差异。饮水摄入的微塑料风险约为鱼类消费的10倍，表明该水库受包装材料、纺织纤维和渔具来源的微塑料严重污染，雨季径流加剧了污染程度。

papers.title: Evolutionary distinctiveness and parasite specificity determine infection of non-native fish
papers.authors: Park, Andrew William; Dáttilo, Wesley; Rubio-Godoy, Miguel; de León, Gerardo Pérez-Ponce
papers.abstract: Abstract While parasites frequently cross the host species barrier and increase their host range, the mechanisms underlying successful novel cross-species transmission remain poorly understood. Host range expansion of complex life-cycle parasites is especially challenging to assess because they use different host species for development and reproduction. Addressing this knowledge gap, we use a large, published dataset on fish–helminth interactions, which includes introduced, non-native fish species, providing an opportunity to examine parasite infection of novel species in the context of a parasite's known phylogenetic host range and the evolutionary distance between non-native fish and native hosts. We found that larval and adult-stage parasites are influenced by distinct factors in determining their host range expansion. Larval parasites with broad phylogenetic host ranges exhibit higher infection success in novel hosts than specialists. In contrast, both specialist and generalist adults can successfully infect new host species. Notably, specialists achieve the highest infection success when novel hosts are closely related to their typical hosts. Our findings provide evidence of the trade-offs associated with specialism and generalism in parasites and enhance our understanding of the ecological and evolutionary constraints shaping host range expansion. These insights are critical for predicting future host–parasite assemblies in the context of global change.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用已发表的鱼类-蠕虫互作数据集，探究非本地鱼类感染机制。发现幼虫期寄生虫的宿主范围广度决定其感染成功率，而成虫期专化性寄生虫在宿主与原生宿主亲缘关系近时感染率最高。研究揭示了寄生虫专化性与泛化性之间的权衡，为全球变化背景下宿主-寄生虫群落预测提供理论依据。

papers.title: A cascading vortex pipe fishway for safe downstream fish passage

papers.summary_cn: 提出一种级联涡管鱼道设计，旨在为鱼类下行洄游提供安全通道。该结构通过涡流引导鱼类顺利通过水工建筑物，减少损伤与死亡率。

papers.title: Surface chemistry as main governing factor in the adsorption of acetaminophen, doxycycline hyclate, and tetracycline on fish and shrimp waste-derived hydrochars
papers.authors: Siddhartha, Tatwadhika Rangin; Ronsse, Frederik; Heynderickx, Philippe M.
papers.summary_cn: 以鱼虾废弃物制备的水热炭为吸附剂，研究其表面化学性质对扑热息痛、强力霉素和四环素吸附行为的主导作用。结果表明，水热炭的表面官能团和电荷特性是决定三种药物吸附容量的关键因素，而非比表面积。该发现为渔业废弃物资源化利用及养殖水体抗生素污染治理提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Circular Urchin Economies for Viable Futures: Designing Material Cultures across Food, Waste, and Aquaculture
papers.authors: Raina, Anastasiia; Hu, Yimei; Huang, Danlei
papers.abstract: Abstract Urchin Futures is a biodesign project that responds to climate change by connecting marine science, biomaterial experimentation, aquaculture, and food culture. Working with marine biologists, aquaculture practitioners, chefs, and ceramicists, we developed a transdisciplinary model that spans marine ecologies, biological knowledge, and seafood waste streams to prototype circular materials and public experiences. Integrating scientific research, biomaterial exploration, and cultural practice, we asked how marine organisms and seafood waste can inform material cultures and public conversations around climate-resilient coastal food systems. Together, we visualized urchin-integrated farming models and prototyped circular material cultures through EchinoDye, EchinoClay, EchinoGlaze, and a participatory dining experience. Our circular approach combines sustainable urchin farming, waste reuse, and gastronomic explorations of urchin roe, while building shared knowledge across research, industry, and community partners.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过跨学科生物设计项目“Urchin Futures”，整合海洋科学、生物材料实验、水产养殖与饮食文化，探索海胆在食物、废弃物及水产养殖中的循环经济模式。团队与海洋生物学家、养殖从业者、厨师及陶艺家合作，开发了EchinoDye、EchinoClay、EchinoGlaze等循环材料原型，并设计参与式餐饮体验，将可持续海胆养殖、废弃物再利用与海胆生殖腺美食创新相结合。研究旨在通过物质文化设计，推动气候适应性沿海食物系统的公众对话与知识共建。

papers.title: Rapid and complete inorganic nitrogen removal from real aquaculture wastewater via heterotrophic nitrification–aerobic denitrification by Pseudomonas putida 4-HYK
papers.authors: Wang, Longqi; Li, Sitong; Wang, Xiaotong; Du, Weiyu; Feng, Shiyu; Wang, Li; Wang, Yuan; Gu, Jing; Cong, Yuting; Lu, Yanan
papers.summary_cn: 利用Pseudomonas putida 4-HYK菌株，通过异养硝化-好氧反硝化（HN-AD）工艺，实现了实际养殖废水中无机氮的快速完全去除。该研究聚焦于高效脱氮菌株的筛选与应用，验证了其在真实废水环境中的处理效能。

papers.title: Editorial: Recent advanced techniques for sustainable aquaculture production
papers.authors: Kumar, Neelesh; Srivastava, Abhishek; Singh, Chandra Pal; Tyagi, Anuj; Behera, Bijay Kumar; Pandey, Pramod Kumar
papers.summary_cn: 这篇社论探讨了可持续水产养殖生产中的前沿技术，旨在推动环境友好型养殖模式的发展。文章综述了包括循环水养殖系统、生物絮团技术及智能监测等创新方法，以提升资源利用效率并减少生态影响。这些技术为应对水产养殖业的环境挑战提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Assessing village-level resource and environmental carrying capacity in an agricultural heritage system: the case of the Wujiang dike–pond agro-aquaculture and sericulture cultural system
papers.authors: Wang, Zhiwei; Zhang, Shenyu; Liu, Ying; Gao, Yuhui; Lin, Mingxin; Nisar, Ubair; Qie, Hongkai
papers.abstract: Introduction Agricultural heritage systems depend on the coordinated maintenance of natural resources, ecological functions, rural livelihoods, and cultural continuity. This study assessed village-level resource and environmental carrying capacity in the Wujiang dike–pond agro-aquaculture and sericulture cultural system. Methods Using 2024 cross-sectional data from 150 administrative villages, a 17-indicator framework covering resource, environmental, and socio-economic carrying capacity was constructed. Village and subsystem scores were calculated using hierarchical entropy weighting, and direct entropy weighting was used to test sensitivity to the weighting structure. Results The hierarchical entropy-weighted ARECC scores ranged from 0.1251 to 0.6840, with significant differences among the seven township groups. Subsystem comparisons showed that similar composite scores could arise from different combinations of resource, environmental, and socio-economic conditions. The two weighting schemes produced positively correlated scores, but village classifications and township rankings were only partly consistent. Regression analysis showed a negative association between pesticide application intensity and the hierarchical entropy-weighted ARECC score. Under direct entropy weighting, the labor-force share showed a marginal positive association and the tertiary-industry output share showed a marginal negative association, indicating that the regression pattern was sensitive to the weighting structure. Discussion These findings indicate that the carrying capacity of an agricultural heritage site depends on the coordinated support of resource endowments, environmental maintenance, agricultural production, livelihoods, institutional support, and cultural transmission. Village-level assessment can identify differentiated constraints and support targeted conservation and adaptive management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以吴江圩田-池塘农业与蚕桑文化系统为例，构建包含资源、环境和社会经济承载力的17项指标框架，利用2024年150个行政村截面数据，通过层次熵权法评估村级资源环境承载力。结果显示，层次熵权ARECC得分范围为0.1251至0.6840，不同乡镇组间差异显著；农药施用强度与承载力得分呈负相关，而劳动力占比和第三产业产出占比的关联性受权重结构影响。研究表明，农业遗产系统的承载力依赖于资源禀赋、环境维护、农业生产、生计、制度支持和文化传承的协调支撑，村级评估可识别差异化约束条件，支持针对性保护与适应性管理。

papers.title: Fruit Processing Residues as Alternative Feed Ingredients in Aquaculture: A Critical Narrative Review of Nutritional Value, Functional Effects and Circular-economy Constraints
papers.authors: Pratiwi, Dian Yuni; Ernawati
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of aquaculture has intensified demand for feed ingredients and renewed interest in low-cost, regionally available materials that reduce reliance on fishmeal and conventional plant proteins. Fruit processing generates large quantities of peels, pomace, seeds, kernels and reject whole fruit, and these residues carry fermentable carbohydrates, dietary fibre, pigments and polyphenolic compounds that have prompted their evaluation as aquafeed components. This review critically synthesises the evidence on fruit-derived residues in finfish and crustacean nutrition, organised around composition, antinutritional constraints, growth and feed-utilisation responses, functional effects on immunity and antioxidant status, pigmentation and product quality, and bioprocessing strategies that modify residue value. The available literature is dominated by short-term feeding trials in a small number of hardy freshwater species, most prominently Nile tilapia, common carp and rainbow trout, with grape pomace, citrus peel, apple pomace, pomegranate residues, banana peel, papaya, watermelon rind, mango kernel and olive cake among the residues examined. Across this evidence, a recurring dose-dependent pattern emerges in which modest dietary inclusion is often tolerated or associated with improved immune and antioxidant indices, whereas higher inclusion tends to depress growth and feed efficiency, an effect commonly attributed to fibre, tannins and other antinutritional factors. Processing interventions, particularly fermentation, are reported to lower antinutrient load and improve nutritional accessibility, but the supporting studies are heterogeneous and rarely standardised. Confidence in generalisable conclusions is limited by inconsistent characterisation of residues, narrow species coverage, an absence of long-term and grow-out data, and few economic or life-cycle assessments. The strongest defensible conclusion is that fruit residues are better positioned as functional or partial ingredients than as primary protein or energy sources. Priorities include standardised residue characterisation, dose-response and long-term trials, mechanistic work on polyphenol-microbiome interactions, and integrated sustainability assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 本文系统综述了水果加工残渣（如果皮、果渣、籽仁等）在水产饲料中的应用潜力，重点分析了其营养价值、抗营养因子限制及对鱼类和甲壳类生长、免疫、抗氧化和产品品质的影响。研究发现，低比例添加（如葡萄渣、柑橘皮等）可改善免疫和抗氧化指标，但高比例添加因纤维和单宁等抗营养因子而抑制生长和饲料效率。发酵等生物加工可降低抗营养负荷，但现有研究缺乏标准化和长期数据。结论认为水果残渣更适合作为功能性或部分替代原料，而非主要蛋白或能量来源，未来需加强残渣标准化表征、剂量-响应试验及可持续性评估。

papers.title: Digestive and antioxidant modulation by anthocyanins from Rubus spp. in black skirt tetra Gymnocorymbus ternetzi: implications for sustainable ornamental aquaculture
papers.authors: Siqueira, Mayara Schueroff; da Silva, Maria Ildilene; Povh, Jayme Aparecido; Kovalski Dias, Carla Larissa; Gimênes-Junior, Heriberto; Nora, Leonardo; Vizzotto, Marcia; da Rocha Concenço, Fernanda Izabel Garcia; Honorato, Claucia Aparecida
papers.abstract: Abstract This study evaluated the effects of dietary supplementation with microencapsulated blackberry anthocyanin extract on pigmentation, antioxidant status, digestive enzyme activity, and histological parameters of black skirt tetra Gymnocorymbus ternetzi . Ninety juveniles were randomly distributed into nine tanks (three tanks per treatment), which were considered the experimental units: a control diet and diets supplemented with 1000 or 2000 mg kg⁻ 1 microcapsules for 30 days. Survival was 100%, and no differences were observed in final weight, feed intake, or viscerosomatic index; however, fish fed 2000 mg kg⁻ 1 exhibited a higher condition factor. Supplementation reduced lightness (L*), resulting in darker body coloration. Amylase and alkaline phosphatase activities increased significantly, while hepatic alanine aminotransferase activity decreased in supplemented groups. Histological analyses revealed improved liver architecture and increased intestinal villus height, accompanied by enhanced goblet cell activity. Antioxidant enzyme activities (SOD and CAT) decreased in supplemented groups, suggesting a modulation of antioxidant responses associated with anthocyanin supplementation. Overall, dietary inclusion of microencapsulated blackberry anthocyanins may promote enhanced pigmentation, improved digestive function, modulation of antioxidant-related biomarkers, and preservation of hepatic and intestinal integrity, supporting its use as a natural functional additive in ornamental aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了微囊化黑莓花青素提取物对黑裙鱼体色、抗氧化状态、消化酶活性及组织学参数的影响。添加2000 mg/kg花青素可提高条件因子、降低体色亮度，并显著增强淀粉酶和碱性磷酸酶活性，同时改善肝脏结构和肠道绒毛高度。抗氧化酶活性降低表明花青素调节了抗氧化反应。微囊化黑莓花青素可作为天然功能性添加剂，促进观赏鱼着色、消化功能和肠道健康。

papers.title: Isolation and characterization of Lactococcus lactis from Anabas testudineus (Bloch, 1792) as a potential probiotic for sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Ali, Nitul; Sarmah, Priyam; Sarma, Dandadhar
papers.summary_cn: 从攀鲈（Anabas testudineus）中分离并鉴定乳酸乳球菌（Lactococcus lactis），评估其作为可持续水产养殖益生菌的潜力。研究通过微生物学方法完成菌株分离与特性分析，重点关注其益生特性。该菌株可能为水产养殖提供生态友好的疾病防控策略。

papers.authors: Abrar, Wahidul; Yousof, Md. Abu; Islam, Md. Ariful; Sarker, Prosonjit Chandra; Haque, Md. Ahsanul; Islam, Md. Sadiqul; Shahjahan, Md.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Asian seabass ( Lates calcarifer ) is a commercially important euryhaline species capable of tolerating a wide range of salinities. It is widely cultured in coastal and brackish‐water environments; however, information on its adaptation and performance under freshwater conditions remains limited. Therefore, the present study investigated the potential of integrating Asian seabass into freshwater aquaculture systems through gradual salinity acclimation and subsequent feeding evaluation. Fry with an initial body weight of 0.45 ± 0.21 g (mean ± standard deviation [SD]) were reared at a salinity of 10 ppt for 90 days and then gradually acclimated to freshwater by reducing the salinity from 10 to 0 ppt over a 30‐day period. A feeding trial using commercial feed, trash fish and live fish was conducted to evaluate growth and health responses in freshwater‐adapted fingerlings under controlled conditions. During saline rearing, fry growth peaked at 6 g with 60% survival. With decreasing salinity (10–7–4–0 ppt), fish weight increased to 8 g with 82% survival at 0 ppt, accompanied by increased haemoglobin levels and decreased blood glucose levels. Chloride cell density decreased progressively with declining salinity. In the freshwater feeding trial, fish fed live fish showed superior growth and specific growth rate with zero mortality, followed by commercial feed and trash fish, whereas trash fish treatment showed the highest mortality (20%). No significant differences in haemoglobin and blood glucose levels were observed among feed treatments, although goblet cell density was highest in fish fed live feed. Overall, the study provides preliminary evidence that Asian seabass can be successfully acclimated to freshwater and maintained under different feeding strategies with acceptable growth and survival.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）在淡水养殖系统中的适应性。通过30天逐步降盐（10→0 ppt）驯化，鱼体重增至8g，存活率82%，血红蛋白升高而血糖降低。淡水饲养试验中，活饵组生长率和存活率最优（零死亡率），商业饲料次之，杂鱼组死亡率最高（20%）。研究表明尖吻鲈可通过渐进盐度驯化成功适应淡水环境，不同投喂策略下均能获得可接受的生长与存活表现。

papers.title: Immunogenicity and Growth Response of Atlantic Salmon to Dietary Inclusion of Marine Diatom, Skeletonema marinoi, Under Vibrio anguillarum Serotype O3 Challenge
papers.authors: Meesala, Kala-Mallik; Adeyemi, Abigeal D.; Janson, Sarah; Hong, Jeongwhui; Polinski, Mark P.; Burr, Gary; Lomas, Michael; Sealey, Wendy M.; Bouchard, Deborah A.; Habte-Tsion, Michael
papers.abstract: Functional feed ingredients with antimicrobial activities are being explored as a tool to mitigate diseases in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar L.). Skeletonema marinoi is a marine diatom known to have antimicrobial activity. Here, two separate experiments, including a growth study (Exp. 1) and a bacterial challenge (Exp. 2), were conducted to evaluate the effects of dietary S. marinoi as a functional feed ingredient on the growth, feed utilization, stress biomarkers, antioxidant defense, and immunogenic responses of Atlantic salmon. In Exp. 1, a 16-week growth trial was conducted in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) stocked with ten fish (59.6 ± 1.6 g, initial weight) in each of five replicate tanks per treatment. Fish were fed twice daily with either the reference diet or the reference diet supplemented with 0.5% S. marinoi. In Exp. 2, a 27-day bacterial challenge with Vibrio anguillarum Serotype O3 (SO3) was conducted in RAS using 36 fish (100–150 g) per 150 L tank in triplicate. Fish were acclimatized to the RAS for 14 days and fed twice daily with the reference or 0.5% S. marinoi diet prior to the bacterial challenge. Blood plasma, liver, and intestine samples were collected after the growth trial, before (initial, 0 day) and post-challenge (5, 10, 27 days). The results indicated that in Exp. 1, there were no significant differences in survival, final weight, weight gain, feed intake, feed efficiency, condition factor, and hepatosomatic index between fish fed the reference diet and 0.5% S. marinoi diet (p > 0.05). In Exp. 2, before challenge, Atlantic salmon fed the diet with 0.5% S. marinoi showed significantly higher superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in comparison to fish fed the reference diet. On day 5 post-challenge, significantly higher hepatic malondialdehyde (MDA) was measured in the 0.5% S. marinoi group compared to the reference group. Plasma immunoglobulin M (IgM) level increased (p < 0.05), and intestinal IgM gene expression was up-regulated after challenge in fish fed 0.5% S. marinoi, in contrast to those fed the reference diet at 27 days post-challenge (p < 0.05). Overall, these findings suggest that S. marinoi is more likely to be associated with immune modulation rather than adverse stress response; however, further work is required to confirm pathogen-specific immunity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了饲料中添加海洋硅藻Skeletonema marinoi对大西洋鲑生长、饲料利用及免疫应答的影响。生长实验显示，0.5%添加量对存活率、增重和饲料效率无显著影响。细菌感染实验表明，添加组在感染后第5天肝脏MDA显著升高，第27天血浆IgM水平和肠道IgM基因表达上调，提示S. marinoi具有免疫调节潜力，但需进一步验证其对特定病原的免疫保护作用。

papers.summary_cn: 2018-2024年英格兰康沃尔搁浅的短喙普通海豚死因分析显示，兼捕（bycatch）仍是主要威胁。研究通过尸检鉴定死亡原因，发现渔业误捕导致的死亡占比显著，强调需加强兼捕缓解措施。

papers.title: Artificial Reproduction, Larval Rearing, and Gonadal Development of the F1 Generation in Shrimp Scad (Alepes djedaba)
papers.authors: Wu, Jinhui; Chen, Wenjun; Yang, Shaosen; Huang, Yongbiao; Wang, Jujing; Zhang, Xiaoxiao; Zhao, Jun; Wang, Junjie
papers.abstract: Alepes djedaba is a coastal fish species of high economic value. However, information on its early developmental biology remains incomplete, which limits its application in large-scale seed production. In this study, fertilized eggs were obtained through hormone-induced spawning. Under controlled conditions, microscopic observation and histological sectioning were used to systematically record and analyze embryonic development, larval growth characteristics, and the gonadal development potential of the artificially bred first-generation (F1) offspring. The results showed that the fertilized eggs of A. djedaba are spherical and pelagic with a single oil globule. The egg diameter is (672.02 ± 10.03) μm, and the oil globule diameter is (189.76 ± 8.82) μm. At a water temperature of 24.50–24.97 °C, embryonic development is divided into 6 periods (20 stages), taking 19 h 28 min to complete hatching with an average hatching rate of 22.9% ± 15.6%. The total length of newly hatched larvae is (1.43 ± 0.09) mm, with an average daily growth of 0.39 mm from 0 to 21 days post-hatching (DPH). Furthermore, the testes of the F1 generation cultured in captivity exhibit complete tissue structures and mature spermatozoa, while the ovaries show orderly development primarily dominated by stage II–III oocytes with some early stage IV oocytes. This confirms at the histocytological level that the artificially bred offspring possess normal gonadal development, providing strong evidence of its reproductive potential. This study clarifies the key stages of early development and the adaptability of A. djedaba in captive environments, providing critical theoretical support and basic data for subsequent large-scale seed production and larval rearing optimization.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过激素诱导产卵获得吉打鲹（Alepes djedaba）受精卵，系统观察了胚胎发育（24.50–24.97°C下分6期20阶段，19小时28分钟孵化，孵化率22.9%±15.6%）及仔鱼生长（0–21日龄日均增长0.39 mm）。组织学证实F1代人工繁殖个体性腺发育正常（精巢结构完整，卵巢以II–III期卵母细胞为主），为规模化苗种生产提供了关键理论依据。

papers.title: SDG14 assessment of progress against sustaining life below water: a case study from Torres Strait
papers.authors: Plagányi, Éva; Murphy, Nicole; Deng, Roy Aijun; Blamey, Laura K.; Brodie, Stephanie; Dutra, Leo X. C.; Edgar, Steven; Parker, Denham; Salee, Kinam; Tonks, Mark
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 基于Torres Strait案例，评估了SDG14（水下生物）目标的进展，分析了该区域在可持续渔业、海洋保护及生态系统健康方面的现状与挑战。研究发现，尽管部分指标有所改善，但过度捕捞和气候变化仍威胁目标实现。
